reviews.text: A clean and well maintained apartment. I had room 5. Plenty of space for one person, and I am sure a couple as well. Good sized bathroom and shower. A nice selection of clean towels was provided. 10 minutes walk from Taksim Square, which has good transport links to all parts of the city, (the cheap Havabus coaches to the airports run from near Taksim Square also). The walk from apartment to Taksim is a steep uphill climb though, but uphill climbs are hard to avoid in Istanbul! Good communication from the host via Airbnb, who sent the entrance codes for the building and room. No real negatives, apart from could have done with a waste bin in the room. I had a great stay.

The host was friendly and communication was good, but unfortunately the apartment was not clean enough.
I saw cockroaches in the kitchen and even a spider in my room, which made my stay uncomfortable.
The location is nice, but the place definitely needs better cleaning and maintenance.

The flat was clean and comfortable, self check-in was convenient and easy, the host was reacheable, communicated clearly, and was flexible when I asked for a change.
The area is very close to Taksim, yet in a less touristy more unpretentious quarter which I appreciated, also less than 10min walk to the airport bus terminal. The building stairs and steep streets in the area aren't great for carrying suitcases.

Happy was great, very easy to get in contact with and very helpful. The space is simple, nice and clean. Bed is big and very comfortable. Location is good too, close to Taksim Square and Istiklal street. I felt safe as a young woman at this accomodation as there are lots of people around nearby. Would stay here again.

Had a great stay here. The location is perfect, very near Taksim metro and the city centre.
The team were very responsive and helpful to any question I had - they were available 24/7.
Internet was good and the flat was very clean.
I also recommend the barber next door and the laundrette across the road!

description:
2nd Floor, NO ELEVATOR

Our freshly refurbished apartment is in a mid-century building with high ceilings, two bedrooms, lots of light, a private shower in one of the bedrooms and modern and comfortable design.

Situated right in the center of Cihangir, with all the best street life, nice cafés either with great quality or casual street enjoyments.

7 minutes walk to the tram to historic peninsula for the best of touristic hot spots; or 10 minutes walk to Taksim Square and Istiklal Street.

reviews.text:
Our stay at Murat’s place was fantastic. Murat is very responsive and gets back to you quickly with any questions. The place is very well located in a lovely neighborhood with lots of restaurants and cafés.
The apartment is very clean and tidy, just as shown in the pictures. Everything works perfectly; the only minor issue was that one of the shower heads in the ensuite bedroom was broken.
I would recommend this place to anyone staying in the area.

There is a sewer smell at the house and the hallway all the time. So bad that is impossible to stay in the house.
When taking shower water gets cold and very hot by itself and it burns if you don’t move quickly to shut the water off.
The house is very old and only kitchen and bathrooms are renovated. Floors make so much noise when walking. There is nothing near elevator to the apartment so you have to carry your stuff many steps up to get to the apartment.
I brought issues to owner’s attention but he said they had these issues in the past and they fixed it and it looks like they have it again.

The apartment is in a great location, close to Taksim Square and surrounded by plenty of restaurants, which gives the area a really nice and lively atmosphere as soon as you step outside. I stayed for 12 nights with my family, and we found the house comfortable throughout our stay. Check-in was easy, the house was clean, and overall, I believe it was very good value for the money. We had a pleasant stay and would recommend it.

A beautiful place! The apartment was very cozy and looked like on the pictures, very clean , renovated and had all the comfort amenities like the dishwasher, fridge, cooking utensils etc. Very spacious and a lot of daylight, tastefully decorated. The location was also great, in a cosy neighborhood walking distance to everything, with a lot of cute cafes and supermarkets. The host was proactive and very responsive, and it was easy to get in due to clear instructions. Would definitely recommend!

Great location in the heart of Cihangir! The apartment was clean and the host was responsive. One thing to note is that there is only one AC unit in the apartment, in the living room, so we had to sleep with our bedroom doors open, but this wasn't an issue for our group.

description: The whole group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located place.

reviews.text:
I had a great stay at this apartment in Istanbul. The hosts were kind and responsive, which made the whole experience very smooth.
The apartment was exactly as shown in the photos—very clean, well-maintained, and equipped with everything needed for a comfortable stay. The internet worked fine, which allowed me to work remotely without issues.
The location is also a big plus. It’s very close to Taksim Square, making it easy to get anywhere in the city. There are plenty of shops, bars, and restaurants nearby, so you always have options within walking distance.
The only small downside is that you can hear quite a bit of street noise, especially on weekends, since the area is lively. However, this is also part of the trade-off for being so centrally located and close to everything.
Overall, I really enjoyed my stay and would definitely recommend it.

description: Apartment is located in a very central location in TAKSİM district and only 5 minutes walking distance from the famous Taksim Square and Istiklal street,where there are many shops,cafes,restaurants and bars are located.There are many convenient stores and amenities nearby where you can buy your provisions.The apartment is tastefully furnished and has a fully equipped kitchen and also a washing machine. Apartment is on 2nd floor . There is an ELEVATOR in the building.

reviews.text: Quick walk to Taksim Square, subway and tram. Everything was accessible from this location. The description of the apartment is accurate. We were primarily there to sleep and spent most of our time out exploring Istanbul. The beds were comfortable the bathroom was clean and the shower was nice. There is air-conditioning in both of the bedrooms. The host was helpful and accommodating. We really enjoyed our stay I would recommend this Airbnb if you want to explore Istanbul.

Hakan is an extremely hardworking and super responsive host. My husband & I carried heavy luggage & Hakan voluntarily helped with our bags both upon arrival & departure. His place was newly renovated, super clean & very well equipped. The beds were comfortable & professionally made to hotel standards. We had more than enough towels & complimentary house slippers. Hakan considered everything when setting up this space, even the extra light over the bathroom mirror was a thoughtful addition for us ladies. The space is small, but the use of large, tastefully appointed mirrors opened up the space, making it appear much bigger. The rain shower was also a welcomed touch. The location is 5 minutes walk to Taksim Square, restaurants, shops & all forms of transportation. The suites are located in the traditional neighborhood amongst the local community, but it felt really safe and was very well lit at night. We would definitely stay with Hakan again. He is such an impressive young entrepreneur.

had an absolutely amazing stay at this apartment in Istanbul! From the moment I arrived, everything exceeded my expectations. The place was spotless, beautifully decorated, and had a very cozy yet modern vibe that instantly made me feel at home.
The location is perfect—close to all the main attractions, restaurants, and public transport, yet still quiet enough to relax after a long day of exploring the city. Waking up there felt like a dream.
The host was incredibly friendly, responsive, and helpful throughout my stay. They made sure everything was perfect and even gave great local recommendations, which really enhanced my experience.
The apartment itself was fully equipped with everything I needed—comfortable bed, fast Wi-Fi, clean bathroom, and a well-organized kitchen. Every little detail was thoughtfully prepared.
Overall, this was one of the best accommodations I’ve ever stayed in. I would 100% recommend it to anyone visiting Istanbul, and I would definitely come back again!

We really enjoyed the place. It is conveniently located close to the metro and bus stops; you can quickly reach the sea shore via funicular. There are plenty of good, inexpensive local stores in the area; İstiklal Avenue—a walkable street filled with shops, restaurants, and many other attractions—is just an 8-minute walk away.
The flat itself is small but fully functional. The building has an elevator, which is very suitable for elderly people. We stayed there in the middle of spring and the temperature inside was very comfortable. The sun does not shine directly into the windows, which makes me think that it shouldn't be too hot there even in summer.
The host was always in contact, ready to resolve any issues.

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment has everything you could need — washing machine with powder, AC, electric stove, all the dishes, cutlery, pot, frying pan, and fridge. Everything works perfectly and the place smells great. It’s close to everything, with convenient public transport nearby, and even a shuttle bus about 10 minutes away that goes to both airports.
The building has an elevator, which was super convenient. Hakan was an amazing host — very responsive, always helpful, and even assisted us with our luggage and information about the airport shuttle. He replied immediately to any questions we had.
Highly recommend this place for a comfortable and easy stay!

description: Have fun with the whole family at this stylish place.

reviews.text:
Perfect Local Experience with Outstanding Hosts!
Ihsan’s modern Fatih apartment (2nd floor, elevator access) was ideal for our group of 6. The brand-new space had every necessity, seamless self check-in via video guide, and a prime local location—exactly the authentic Istanbul immersion we wanted.
Ihsan was proactive, responsive, and genuinely caring, while his father’s surprise visit with traditional treats warmed our hearts. The apartment’s cleanliness, modern design, and quiet yet central Fatih location made it a flawless base.
Highly recommended for travelers prioritizing local charm, modern comfort, and hosts who go above and beyond. We’ll gladly stay here again—thank you, Ihsan, for an unforgettable stay!

Communication with Ihsan was effortless from the very beginning. He shared many useful links to recommended attractions and restaurants.
The apartment was clean and comfortable. We really appreciated the snacks and bottled water that were waiting for us when we checked in. Ihsan’s hospitality was exceptional, and we were especially touched by the kindness of his father, who brought us fresh fruit multiple times during our stay. It was such a thoughtful gesture that made us feel truly cared for.
The apartment was in a quiet, safe neighborhood, away from the crowds and noise of the main tourist areas, yet public transportation was nearby. There was also a seaside promenade just a 10-minute walk away.
Overall, we had a very nice experience and we felt more like we were staying in our own home than in a rental. We would definitely recommend this accommodation to anyone looking for a relaxing, comfortable, and welcoming stay.

Newly furnished apartment, very spacious and clean. Has air-conditioning in most rooms and the living room has a beautiful view of the Galata Tower and surrounds. The building has an elevator, which us convenient it is a walkable distance from Fatih Mosque, public transport and authentic local Turkish shops and restaurants. Ihsan the host was very friendly and responsive and really made us feel very welcome and comfortable.
Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend.

After reading the positive reviews by previous visitors I was genuinely blown away by Ihsan and his apartment. We were a family of 7 with young kids so cleanliness and space were absolute priorities for us.
The apartment was in beautiful condition and had ample space as shown in the pictures. Two bathrooms and three bedrooms really made our stay pleasant.
I really want to continue praising Ihsan as he also helped with our airport transport and provided local recommendations.
In addition to the amazing, clean and spacious apartment, the helpful host, I must also praise Ihsan's father who lived upstairs. He is a saint and made our stay that extra special.
I will definitely recommend the apartment to family and friends, and may come visit again soon.

This page is not enough for me to write my best experience about his place and his outstanding hospitality!

His father lives on the top floor, He Greated each of the units to make sure we are okay also brought fruits , water bottles and cookies. He is such a Great and kind man!!
The place is spacious, Great and clean furnitures , extra sheets and blankets,elevator for convenience and the basement has so much natural light that you don't feel like it's basement. loved the two full baths , laundry room with detergent provided, nice kitchen, three bedrooms and spacious living room.
My family and I loved this place and definitely will recommend it to anyone visiting Istanbul.
I appreciate the outstanding Hospitality!!

description:
Guest access
Guests have full private access to the apartment. The building’s amenities including security, elevators, and indoor parking are also available for guest use.

description:
Stay in the heart of Istanbul’s historic center, surrounded by the timeless beauty of the Old City.
Our apartment is just steps away from the city’s most iconic landmarks, allowing you to explore Istanbul’s rich history and culture with ease
• Hagia Sophia Mosque – 4-minute walk
• Blue Mosque (Sultanahmet Mosque) – 4-minute walk

• Tram Station – 1-minute walk

reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay! The home was very cozy and clean, exactly as shown in the pictures. We were warmly welcomed by Cem, who was very helpful and made us feel at home. The location is perfect for tourists — close to everything, and only a 2-minute walk to the tram station. The house is well-equipped, with filtered drinking water and hot water in the bathroom. Everything was just as described. We really enjoyed our stay and highly recommend this place!

Cem was a great host. Friendly, welcoming, and very attentive throughout our stay.
The bathroom looked a little different from what was shown in the photos, but overall the apartment matched the listing well. One thing worth noting is that some of the windows in the living room only had sheer curtains, so quite a bit of light comes in during the morning. If you plan to sleep on the bed in the living room, you may want to bring an eye mask.
Also, the apartment is located on the second floor and there is no elevator, so this is something to keep in mind if you have limited mobility or are traveling with someone who does.

I can’t say enough good things about our stay! Cem was the consummate host, making what otherwise could have been a tough-to-navigate visit to Istanbul easy & completely stress free. Cem arranged our transportation from the airport to the apartment, which is located on a picturesque street above a wonderful café called Coffee No. 4 in the heart of the Sultanahmet district, walkable to everything Old Town Istanbul has to offer. Cem greeted us with the warmest welcome and the most delicious Turkish pistachio coffee that he personally prepared using a traditional method of boiling it in hot sand! Cem was always available to answer questions, and it was obvious he truly cares about his guests. The apartment was charming, clean & perfectly sized for the 3 of us, and the location simply can’t be beat. The icing on the cake was the amazing vintage sidecar motorcycle tour, Fourside of Istanbul, that Cem took us on & that I can’t recommend enough to anyone staying here – it was our highlight!!

The apartment was adequate for a short stay of one or two nights, and the location was convenient. Communication with the host was good and check-in was straightforward.
However, there were several aspects that could be improved. The bathroom is in need of renovation, and we found the stairs quite steep and potentially unsafe. The apartment’s design is functional for sleeping, but the common area was not particularly comfortable for relaxing or spending time indoors. The kitchen was also quite sparsely equipped.
Overall, it worked for a brief stay, but it did not fully meet our expectations in terms of comfort and amenities.

We had a wonderful stay and couldn’t have asked for a better location. The apartment was clean, comfortable and just a couple of minutes’ walk from Sultanahmet Square, with the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Basilica Cistern and Topkapı Palace all so close. The nearby tram was incredibly easy to use and made this the perfect base for exploring Istanbul. A special mention to Cem, the co-host we communicated with throughout. He was fantastic – attentive, friendly and always very quick to respond. He sent us a detailed list of things to see and do, useful information and recommendations for breakfast, lunch and dinner. He also arranged our Bosphorus boat tour and airport transfers both ways, and even offered complimentary tea and coffee at the café below. We felt so well looked after. We would absolutely stay here again and recommend it to family and friends. Thank you Cem for helping make our Istanbul trip so memorable! ❤️🇹🇷

description:
Enjoy a stylish experience in our centrally located apartment in the heart of Sultanahmet – just a 5-minute walk to the Hagia Sophia & Blue Mosque.

You can expect many cafés & restaurants in the immediate vicinity, self check-in, a personal guide with insider tips – and a 20% breakfast discount at the hotel next door!

We are a young couple from Germany and share our first Airbnb here – with everything we love ourselves: comfort, tranquility & real hospitality.

reviews.text: Ufuk and Eda Are really nice and caring hosts. The Appartement was exactly like described and really clean. It is located in a quited area but at the Same time it’s only a few minutes walk away to some main spots like the Blue mosque and Hagia Sophia. Also it’s only a few steps to the waterfront and the public transport. We felt very welcome. Thanks a ton

This is a very nice modern Airbnb. The space is clean, the furniture is comfortable, bathroom is spotless and wifi is fast. The location is excellent being very close to many nice restaurants and major attractions. The neighborhood itself is charming and quiet overnight. The rooftop terrace offers a glimpse of the Blue Mosque and the sea. We rode the airport bus and walked the last 6 minutes (uphill) to the apartment without problem. Ufuk is an excellent host and responded quickly to our questions. Overall we were very pleased with this Airbnb and we recommend.

The location was perfect - easy walking distance to the main sites but tucked away on a quiet side street, and the bed was comfortable.
As an older couple, we prefer to sleep in and take it easy, cooking our own breakfasts at our apartment and coming back midday to rest as needed. In these aspects we found the apartment a bit challenging (the kitchen counter top space was very limited and the stairs were quite steep, and without an adequate railing), and we made some specific suggestions to our hosts. Their response was immediate and very positive and we are confident they will make the improvements we recommended.

Great apartment very close to some of the most famous mosques in Istanbul, great restaurants and convenience stores. Location is great and it's also on a quiet street, so it's great to sleep at night as well.
The apartment itself was very clean and we'll kept with really great design choices, the only little drawback I hadn't realized was that even though there is a small kitchen, there's no stove, oven or microwave, hence no way to heat up food, but that did not get in the way of having a great time.
Shower is great, tv and bed as well, so overall I had a very comfortable stay.
The hosts are also great, friendly and super responsive, they also even let me know when there was a power outage in the street to be able to accommodate me, great people.
Would recommend and definitely would stay here again.

Communication was excellent from booking to departure, apartment was located a short walk from the major tourist attractions and restaurants, it was clean and comfortable. In short, it was exactly what we hoped for.

description: Our place is centrally located on the Kadıköy pier. Our hotel has been newly renovated and is fully equipped for your service. Since our region is central, it is easy to get around. There are all kinds of opportunities around us.

description:
Stay in a unique serviced apartment within The Muradiye Luxury Apartments by Casa Calma Collections, a beautifully restored heritage building designed by renowned architect Vedat Tek.

Perfectly located between Galata Tower and the Old City, next to Galataport and the Bosphorus.

Elegant design, full amenities, and easy access to all transport lines make it ideal for both leisure and business stays.

On-site security is available between 8 PM–8 AM and daily housekeeping service is provided.

reviews.text: Munir and Gorkem were very helpful and responsive. The apartment was beautiful, clean, comfortable beddings, good water pressure. Location is really good and walkable to many sites and neighborhoods. Lots of space for family and friends. Beautiful rooftop with great views.

Amazing flat in Istanbul! The place was clean, comfortable, and had a beautiful view. Everything was exactly as shown, and the location was perfect. The host Münir was kind, helpful, and quick to respond. I really enjoyed my stay and would definitely come back!

A Wonderful Five-Star Stay in Istanbul
What a beautiful experience. Our family of four, including two teenage boys, had a warm, comfortable, and truly memorable stay. From the moment we landed in Istanbul until the morning of our departure, the manager remained in contact. Despite our late-arriving flight, he personally waited to welcome us, showed us around, and ensured that we were comfortably settled into our home away from home.
We have stayed at several five-star hotels and residences during our travels, and this property deserves the same recognition. From the moment we walked through the door, we knew you had found somewhere special.
The apartment was immaculate, beautifully designed, and exceptionally well equipped. The refrigerator was stocked with water, and the coffee selection was excellent, with both Nespresso and freshly ground coffee available. The common areas were spotless and inviting, the bedrooms were spacious, and the beds were extremely comfortable.

We had a wonderful stay! The host was incredibly responsive, kind, and helpful throughout the whole trip. The apartment is absolutely beautiful, with an amazing view and a perfect location. Everything was comfortable and exactly as described. We would gladly stay here again and highly recommend it!

had a wonderful stay at The Muradiye Luxury Apartment Apartment. The place was very clean, comfortable, and well-equipped with everything needed for a relaxing stay. The location was excellent and convenient for getting around. Munir was extremely kind, responsive, and helpful throughout the entire stay, making the experience even better. I highly recommend this apartment to anyone visiting the area and would definitely stay here again!

description: Our room combines comfort and functionality. You can prepare your coffee in your own small kitchen and start the day with pleasure, and relieve the tiredness of the day in a calm and clean environment. Ideal for both short and long stays, it offers a warm, friendly and considerate space

reviews.text:
I had a wonderful stay at Ramazan’s apartment in Taksim. The location is perfectright in the heart of Istanbul and within walking distance of Taksim Square, restaurants, shops, and public transportation.
The apartment was exceptionally clean, well-maintained, and exactly as described. Everything was comfortable and thoughtfully prepared, making me feel at home from the moment I arrived.
Ramazan was an outstanding host: friendly, responsive, and always ready to help with anything I needed. His hospitality made my stay even more enjoyable.
I highly recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Istanbul. I would definitely stay here again!

I stayed at the hotel for 10 days and I really enjoyed it. The room was clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed for a longer stay. The bed was good for sleeping well every night, and the space felt nice and quiet.
The staff were friendly and helpful from check-in to check-out – always happy to answer questions or sort things out quickly.
The location worked perfectly for what I needed, and overall it was a relaxing and hassle-free experience. Good value too. I'd happily come back if I'm in Istanbul again.

We had a wonderful experience with Ramazan in Taksim. Although we arrived very late and faced some initial challenges with our room, Ramazan went above and beyond to relocate us to a space that better accommodated our children. He is incredibly sympathetic toward parents and clearly prioritizes the comfort of families.
The location is unbeatable as it is literally a 3 minute walk to Taksim Square, the Metro, and Istiklal Street. This offers fantastic value for the price. As a new owner of just one month, Ramazan’s enthusiasm for hospitality is clear. While the building is older and some amenities in the rooms could benefit from refreshment, his passion for service shines through and he has exciting plans for future renovations. He was always quick to respond, highly accessible, and gave us excellent local suggestions for exploring Istanbul. If you want a host who truly cares and a location that puts you in the heart of the city, this is a great choice!

I want to start by saying that the receptionist, Ramazan, was very kind and helpful. He deserves a 5-star mention for his service; he listened to my concerns and moved me to a larger room, which I truly appreciated. The location of the building is great as it is near everything. However, my first room was very small and dark, with buildup along the edges of the floors and corners. The bathroom was tiny and the toilet did not flush.
​While the price is low and the location is convenient, guests should be aware that the actual rooms do not match the photos provided. However, I want to thank Ramazan for his help and assistance.
Excellent stay overall. The room was clean, quiet, and comfortable, and the location was ideal. Communication with the host (Ramazan) was smooth, and check-in was easy. Highly recommended.

description: ✨ Cozy studio in the heart of Galata, perfect for couples or small groups. The apartment features one comfortable double bed 🛏️ and a divan where one additional guest can easily stay. Stylishly designed and thoughtfully equipped for a relaxing visit. Just steps away from charming historic streets, cafés, and iconic landmarks 🏙️ Enjoy comfort, convenience, and the authentic Galata atmosphere all in one stay 🌿

reviews.text: Myself and my partner were very staying here, it was surprisingly peaceful and within very good walking distance of Galata Tower and great restaurants and Istiklal street. We were very happy everything was as described and the host was great. I recommend it!

I had very good communication with the host. The location is excellent, right next to Galata Tower, with a view of the Bosphorus from the bedroom. Everything was very clean and well maintained. Overall, it was a very pleasant experience.

Great location on the European side. Super close to Galata Tower and a short walk to the river. Hosts provided really clear instructions for getting there. Felt very comfortable in this nice apartment.

Great location, the street outside is actually quiet for me. But the horn of the cruise on the contrary is the alarm that wakes me up. Shower room is a bit small, even for Asian. Other than that, communication is smooth. They even provide us a place(not on the site, but next to Taksim square). Everything is great and public transportation is near too!
Harika bir konum. Tüm turistik yerlere yakın. Daire temizdi ve ihtiyacımız olan her şey vardı. Ev sahibi ilgili ve ulaşılabilirdi. Genel olarak memnun kaldık.

description:
Stay just 400 meters from Taksim Square and Istiklal Street, in the heart of Beyoğlu, with easy access to public transportation, shops, cafés, and major attractions, all while being on a quiet residential street.

This thoughtfully designed apartment offers a smart layout with the feel of both a studio and a one-bedroom. The living area and bedroom are on opposite sides, connected by a central kitchenette and bathroom.

reviews.text: The host was very kind, and the room was clean and comfortable. It's in a great location, so I had a very pleasant stay. Highly recommended!

The stay was great! Sanaz and her colleagues were really helpful and kind, replied fast to any questions. Apartment was clean and cozy. Even though we had a small problem after arrival - the host quickly replied to us and PHYSICALLY came to the apartment on Sunday afternoon to fix the issue. So grateful for that. Location was good, all amenities are close by, though the view from was a bit not aesthetic. Overall, great experience, I recommend staying with Sanaz 🙏

Ich war 8 Tage in der Unterkunft von Sanaz. Ich kann es sehr empfehlen und werde es definitiv wieder buchen wenn ich nach Istanbul komme. Es sieht aus wie auf den Fotos, ist sauber und man fühlt sich sofort wohl.
Ich kam früh an und Sanaz und ihr Team haben mir ein früheren Check-In möglich gemacht und mir mit meinem Gepäck geholfen, das gleiche beim Check-Out. Ich habe mich wirklich super wohl gefühlt, immer schnell eine Antwort und Hilfe bekommen.

Danke an Sanaz und das Team ☺️

The location is good.Near the Taksim Square.There’s metro station nearby.Very close to the Istiklal Avenue.There are lots of restaurants and shops there. You won’t miss them out. If I go to Istanbul again I will stay here again!

description:
Charming 1-bedroom apartment in a 19th-century building just moments from Galata Tower. Featuring a cozy bedroom, full kitchen, modern bathroom, and inviting living area, it blends historic character with modern comfort.

Located on Galata’s most vibrant street, cafés and city life are right outside your door. While well-insulated, guests highly sensitive to sound may prefer a quieter residential setting. Wake up to the soul of Istanbul and return to timeless charm after a day of exploring.

reviews.text:
The place was excellent;very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was also very good, with everything we needed nearby, which made our stay even more enjoyable.
The only downside was the entrance to the building. To reach the front door, you had to pass through tables from nearby café which made access a bit inconvenient.

The flat corresponds well to the description.
- It is quite spacious for 1-2 people, and it was very clean when I arrived in it. The communication with Daria was very easy.
- Since it is located in the most busy street of Galata neighborhood, it is pretty noisy from early in the morning until late at night. Make sure when you book that you are not sensitive to the noise.

The flat itself, lovely. Really nice decor, bathroom and comfy bed. The location was super convenient but also had it's cons too. Being above a coffee shop that plays super loud music (seems to be the only one on the street that does too) was a bit annoying. Plus the kitchen for the coffee shop is within the same building meaning the staff are constantly using the door downstairs which you can hear until the early hours. I'd still recommend staying here though because this issue is easily solved with ear plugs!

It was a great place and wonderful location. Amazing hosting, even thou we haven't seen him, but he was always available online and fast in responses. For the future guests important information. If you are looking for a quiet location and peaceful place with few people and no noise, this is not a place to stay. So set your expectations correctly. This is an old town with one of the most touristic streets. There are endless number of people all the time and it only cools down around 1:00 AM at night. Just so you know.
Great place and a great location. Super comfortable bed!

reviews.text:

The apartment felt smaller than it appeared in the photos, and the drying rack took up much of the available space.
We appreciated the welcome snacks, bottled water, and towels. The only thing we missed was a clearly labeled shampoo.
Overall, everything matched the description, and we were happy with our stay.

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment! The location was perfect, right near Taksim Square and close to everything we needed. It was very convenient for restaurants, shops, transportation, and exploring Istanbul.

reviews.text: Balat’ta, tramvaya ve restoranlara çok yakın, Demir Kilise’ye yürüme mesafesinde çok güzel bir konaklama deneyimi yaşadık. It's a quiet and nice place to stay. 5 minutes to tramway station, a great recommendation where to take a breakfast, a big amount of local stores and cafés. Absolutely recommend this place

description: Discover Istanbul’s charm in our cozy Galata suite: Welcome to your private apartment in the heart of Beyoglu, where our cozy and comfortable suite awaits you.

reviews.text:
I spent five nights in Missy's apartment in April. And overall, I would definitely stay there again :)
To provide a bit more detail:
positive:
- good communiction with Missy, timely replies
- smooth check-in without any issues
- central location near public transport and near Istiklal
- photos on AirBnB are realistic and accurate
- apartment was super clean
- less noisy at night than expected (given the cental location)
- strong wifi
- very good value for money
areas for improvement:
- only Turkish-speaking TV-channels available
- no blackout curtains in the bedroom

There were so many Airbnb options when we were looking for a space that we were overwhelmed with analysis paralysis. We overthought location. Do we stay towards Galata? Taksim? Away from Istiklal Street? I was adamant that I wanted access to a washing machine, and I wanted it in the unit so I wouldn't have to worry about timing. And in poring over pictures of apartments, they all started blurring into each other.
I can't even remember how we decided to send an invitation request to Missy for this space, but we're so glad we did!
The apartment is modern, with clean lines in the IKEA styling and a layout that makes excellent use of the space. We had a wall of tall windows in the living room that filled the space with ample daylight; they're arranged bay-window-style, so you could throw the windows open and sit in the nook, sip coffee, and watch people come up and down the street (not a particularly busy street though).
We preferred to eat at "home" most evenings, and the kitchen has all the pots and pans and kitchen staples we needed to cook. We picked up most items at the Carrefour or Macrocenter, but we also had a tiny grocer on our street where we could pick up staple vegetables.
The washing machine is in the unit (yay!), and there was already detergent in the cupboard, so I was able to do laundry to my heart's content. It's a combo wash and dry, so it does take double the time to do a small load but being in the unit meant I could let it run overnight.
The location was perfect. It was on a side street just down the hill from Istiklal Street. I always had to do a little mental preparation to hike up the hill because I only have one walking speed (turbo). We could go down the hill and around the corner to get to Galata (5-7 min). We could walk to the other end of Istiklal Street and get to Taksim Square (15 min). We rented a car for our trip and kept it in a nearby garage (25-30 lira a day and about a 5 min walk from the apt.
My fiancé and I frequently remarked on how lucky we were to find Missy's space for all the things above, but we didn't truly appreciate her until we had an issue with the hot water one morning. I just figured I'd probably need to message her, and it wouldn't be fixed until the evening if we were lucky, and a couple of days if we were realistic. My fiancé called her at the number she left on the contact sheet, while I messaged her in the Airbnb app. I didn't know where we'd reach her first. She answered us both nearly at the same time. And got the hot water fixed within an hour! With communication being so important, it wouldn't be weird to think this was the cherry on top of our experience!
We will LOVE to stay here again if we have the chance to travel to Istanbul again!

Missy's place is ideally located near the famous Istakelal street. The place is only a 3 mins walk from Istakelal/Sishane metro station on one side and 7 mins walk from the Tophane tram station on another. Despite being very close to a very happening area, the house is quiet and we were able to sleep really peacefully during our stay.
There are plenty of grocery stores nearby and almost unlimited food options on Istakelal. There is also a vegan restaurant close by which serves a really good hummus plate.
The house itself is perfect. A few stairs to the elevator, cooking amenities are sufficient, washing/drying facilities are complete. The house is very clean with a great bathroom and ample storage space.
The host is very gracious and was waiting for us when we arrived. She showed us around the apartment and even later communication was very easy. She also booked a cab for us back to the airport which was really helpful.
Small points to consider though we had no problem:
The apartment is a steep uphill from Tophane and a few stairs to the elevator. Also the bed is on the smaller side for a couple.

Missy's place was beyond expectation!
It was cosy, clean, nicely furnished with modern furniture and equipped with everything that you need - washing machine, iron, hair dryer, etc. She even provided detergent to wash the clothes (not all host will provide this!). Stayed for 4 nights, it was truly a home away from home.
Despite the building was located in a hilly area, the location was really strategic. 8 minutes walk down the street to the tram station (Tophane Station), or 5 minutes walk up the street to the famous Istiklal Street. There is small mini mart next door if you need to buy mineral water (Missy does provide complimentary bottle of water), plenty of other small mini marts along the street, and our favorite is the small shop selling delicious Borek down the street. Of course, you'll be spoilt for choice of eateries along Istiklal Street.
Despite we did not had the chance to meet Missy in person, communication with Missy was very smooth. She was very prompt in responding to messages, day and night. Missy was kind enough to accommodate our early check-in (2 am) and late check-out.
We truly enjoyed our stay and looking forward to stay here again during our next visit to Istanbul. Best value for money & totally recommended.
One thing to note for future guests : There are two flights of stairs that you need to take before going into the elevator in the building.

Missy’s place was just as what everyone has described! Spotlessly clean, comfortable and with a really great location. It was easy to walk to Istiklal or to the metro station at Tophane where we could easily explore other areas.
We love that Missy was so thoughtful and prepared some snacks and drinks for us too. Every amenity was provided for and the apartment really lacked nothing!
Missy was very kind and helpful in providing instructions, she was able to let us check in earlier as we had reached in the morning after our flight. She also helped us to call a taxi for our flight out of Istanbul. The apartment was located on a steep slope, so we would recommend to take a taxi if you are arriving with large luggages, but otherwise without suitcases it will be an easy climb along the hill. We loved the apartment and thank you again Missy for showing us your kind hospitality!

description:
The modern and centrally located apartment is an oasis of peace not far from Istiklal Caddesi and Galata Tower, in the middle of Beyoglu.
To make your stay comfortable from the start, airport shuttle can be organized.
The house and also the apartment have just been renovated (new windows, facade renovation, renovation of building services).

reviews.text:
We came to Istanbul in spring to discover this fascinating city and to work remotely. This flat was the ideal accommodation for us. It is as lovingly decorated as seen in the photos, very clean and comfortable. The central district around Istiklal street, as well as the main metro line, is within walking distance, yet the apartments street is very quiet.
The WiFi was fast enough to work directly from the flat and grocery stores are just around the corner. The host is very helpful. She gave us fantastic restaurant recommendations and also recommended a co-working space which I used for an important meeting.
In short, definitely an insider tip and worth every cent. I recommended it to other friends.

I loved this flat. I stayed for six weeks and it was lovely. The location is very central, but just slightly set off from the hubbub. The neighborhood is a real mahalle, which I loved--the fruit seller, the guys at the market, the guys at the bakery all made me feel like a local. The apartment is bright and clean and spacious, if a little shabby. The beds were comfortable, and the shower was truly amazing. It is three, very tall, flights of stairs up, and you do have to bring in your own water, so it can be a good workout. The kitchen has most everything you need, although the cookware is a bit beat up. The wifi was fine for video calls. The host was always responsive and very helpful.

We enjoyed a month in this apartment. The location is good; walkable to Taksim Square, Galata Tower, Istiklal Street and options for public transport. Although it’s close to many tourist attractions it still felt like authentic inner city living in Istanbul. There are some small local shops very close by and we already miss the local baker that sells the freshest breads including simit. The apartment is a good size, clean and is well equipped in the kitchen with plenty of crockery.
For us we would have enjoyed it having a tv, more comfortable sofa and some cooling. Depending on how long you stay and the weather this might not be an issue. Other reviews have mentioned the stairs to the apartment and they could definitely be a challenge for some people.
The host was a pleasure to deal with, very quick to respond to any questions. A genuine and kind person. Thank you

My favorite Airbnb of all time!
Location:
The Airbnb is located in a very center but quite place.
(about 10 minutes aways from the main street - istiklal street)
You have various shops/markets nearby the apartment where you can buy veggies, fruits and other essentials. My market to go was Özmar Market which is 2 minutes away from the apartment. The two owners are really friendly and you have a wide range of choice.
The neighborhood in general is really lovely.
Apartment:
You get what you see! The apartment is exactly like we expected it to be regarding the pictures we saw. it was really clean and comfy.
If you don’t feel like eating in a restaurant, you can simply cook in the apartment as there are enough kitchen tools available.
I literally felt in love with the kitchen!!
Host:
A big compliment to the host!!
Quick response and always willing to help whenever we needed something whether it was concerning the city itself or the apartment.
Our experience:
10 out of 10! ☺️

The apartment is nice, clean and comfortable. Istiklal Street is a short walkway. The location is perfect. The terrace at the top roof offers a nice view of the city. Very helpful host quick response . Good value for money. We will definitely come back again

description:
Fully furnished flat in Istanbul’s first tripled towers - Dumankaya Ikon Residence.
Enjoy the view to the City and Marmara sea in my flat 2+1 located on the 38th floor. The property is located in Ataşehir near to city center in Asian side of Istanbul.

reviews.text:
The apartment had everything a guest could wish for and more!
Comfort and style exceeded all expectations.
Everything in the apartment was brand new and of a high standard, making the apartment a home away from home while visiting Istanbul, where everything you needed to cook, clean or relax were provided.
The large smart TVs with Netflix and comfy corner sofa allowed me to relax post surgery.
The views and size of the apartment gave it a luxury feel, as did the guest slippers provided.
The hosts were accommodating & were on hand with any communication queries to do with the apartment and also general queries about taxis etc which was extremely helpful.
Would be a pleasure to stay in the apartment again - I wish it was my home!
Many thanks to the hosts for an enjoyable stay!

Güneri and Irina are very friendly and kind persons.
We stayed 23 day in the apartment. The Apartment was same as described. Both hosts are very friendly and the response was always quickly. It was our first experience on Airbnb and we are 100% happy with our choice.
We would recommend Güneri und Irina´s place in Istanbul if someone want to have peaceful holidays in a very beautiful and peaceful place.
Thank you Güneri and Irina, we make good memories in Istanbul.

Cozy and lovely furnished apartment with a breathtaking view! Near the apartment building, there are plenty of grocery stores and nice cafes offering local food.
Hosts are amiable and open to any requests you may have. Thank you!
PS it's not really a touristy location, but you can reach the main shopping malls, and Kadikoy/Moda districts in a few minutes by taxi or bus.
By the way, for taxis - use inDriver app since Uber/BiTaksi is almost useless, moreover, in Uber/BiTaksi drivers manually enter the ride fee, and can scam you if you do not pay enough attention to the taximeter on the mirror.

If you looking home away from home - it's the right choice. The supermarket is in a complex and the building has private parking, but your car must be registered a few days in advance. International plate numbers can not be read sometimes but on-site security will open the gate manually. For long-term guests pool and gym is available. The apartment is well equipped and everything is new and in good condition. A great view from the 38th floor is a great bonus and the price is fair enough to stay even for a month or longer. Thanks.

Irina is a very helpful lady. She will try to walk you through any issue you might have and assist you with any difficulty.
The place is amazingly nice, makes you feel at home since the second you step inside!

description: 1 + 1 Deluxe Apartment in a New Building - A Few Steps from Taksim Square

reviews.text: Well, overall it was a pretty good stay considering money:value ratio. The room was clean, had 2 separate beds, and our towels and amenities were renewed regularly. The downside was that the room had almost no natural light coming in, and wifi was just horrible. If you're looking for a stay with good wifi - this is not it.

There was a problem with the water so Ata directed me to a hotel instead of the Airbnb location. The hotel was nice, I was in a deluxe room but the point is that was not the original place I reserved. No complaints about the hotel though.

Unfortunately, due to plumbing issues, we could not stay in the apartment listed. Mr Ata however provided us with a stay in a good quality hotel. We requested and got 2 hotel rooms so our baby could sleep in silence. This was very kind of mr Ata.
Luckily we didn't need a kitchen anyways so this was a good solution for us.
The host has changed the apartment for 2 hotels room which was ok for us. Communication was great!
Konum olarak taksime çok yakın. Kaldığımız tesisde en ufak detaylar düşünülmüş. Temizlik ve konfordan memnun kaldık

description:
The apartment is on fourth floor and there is no elevator.(first and second floors are local residents)
The apartment was renovated on 2015 and it is very modern as the pictures,You can be sure that the apartment is more than the pictures...
There is one bedroom and one living room and a corridor.The TV has NETFLIX,YOUTUBE with android TV application.
Kitchen has amenties for cooking.
You will enjoy the special Balcony...

reviews.text:
We stayed at Fuat's place for 15 nights, and it was fantastic. The loft matched the pictures perfectly—comfortable and well-maintained. The balcony was my favorite spot for morning breakfasts. The bathroom was clean with good water pressure.
The location is perfect: a 10-minute walk to Taksim Square and Istiklal Street, with many restaurants, a supermarket, and a charming bread shop nearby. Public transportation was convenient, with a bus stop and the Taksim metro station within walking distance.
Neighbors Sema and Omar were incredibly helpful, as were our responsive hosts, Fuat and Suliman. The only challenge was the lack of an elevator, but Fuat and Suliman assisted with our luggage.
The building, dating back to 1888, added historical charm to our stay. For the price, it was an excellent deal. We felt safe, comfortable, and well taken care of. Five stars to Fuat, Suliman, Sema, and Omar. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Istanbul.

Overall we had a good stay. The location is excellent, the terrace is fantastic, and communication with the host was always easy and friendly.
That said, the apartment feels much more worn in real life than it appears in the listing photos. A number of things are quite dated, some items need repair, and the overall level of maintenance and cleanliness could definitely be improved. Nothing was catastrophic, and considering the price point we were not expecting luxury, but the place would benefit from a bit more upkeep and attention to detail.
Still, there are clear positives here, especially the outdoor space and the location.

Ismail's flat is a nice choice if you are not taller than 162cm. Yeap. When I saw description of the appartment "The Ceiling of Bathroom and Bedroom is mot high so it can be problem for taller guest." I decided that I and my 164cm will feel comfortable. But no-no-no. It was so unpleasant during showering, because all the time I was beating the ceiling with my head! And that's with my height...
The floor is (if count from 0) on the 4th floor. Going upstairs to the apartment after a day of walking was a bit hard even for young couple as we are. As for bed linen: awful, not new, with pills/pellets (катышки). 😱 That's inappropriate for such price. The water after shower is everywhere in the bathroom & the corridor. The kitchen: there is no enough space for cooking & uncomfortable low pallet table for eat.
Pros: nice view on old neighbourhood from the terrace, big dining room, Wi-fi speed, location.
My conclusion: the flat for really tiny people. But believe me in all other cases it is a pricy bad deal.

The check-in process is simple, and the hosts are excellent at responding to messages. Although the apartment is in a decent place, you may be hesitant at first with the neighbourhood but the location is safe. Prepare yourself in advance if you plan to carry heavy luggage because the apartment's steps have an odd style.
Although the house is generally clean, we were hesitant to use the bed sheets as they were old. The seating all across the flat needs to be cleaned as they were somewhat spots on them.
Bring flip flops or sandals because there isn't a curtain or separate shower area, so the restroom gets floaded every time (the flat has sandals if you are ok to use them). The apartment likely has shower supplies left over from past tenants if you're willing to use shared soaps and shower gels.

Such a good apartment to stay during your visiting of Turkey. I’ve rented this apartment for 18 days and totally enjoyed my stay.
Small, cozy, perfect for 2 or maybe 3 people. Top floor with big patio and amazing view of Istanbul.
Bakery, grocery store, fruits, veggies and greens - everything 1 minutes walk from building on a same street. 5-6 minutes walk you will find 24/7 local small grocery store, and 20 minutes walk from apartment you will find big store carrefour with huge selection of international and local food.
15-20 minutes walk to Galata Tower and 30-40 minutes walk to the main tourist places like Sultan Ahmet Mosque and Aya Sophia. I’ve walked everyday and enjoyed city views.
Area are totally safe with very friendly locals. Most of them speak English and will help you with any questions and requests. If you need help or any advice just smile and ask them. Area very authentic and I really enjoy it. A lot of old buildings with nice and unique architecture.
Two things I did not like at this place. First one - internet. Wi-fi connection was tricky and disconnected every 10-15 minutes. Internet speed good enough to watch YouTube or Netflix but on low or medium video quality. Forget about HD streaming.
Second one - sewerage. Everyday I felt odor from sewer and it was not good. It wasn’t disgusting but if you sensitive to smells it may disturb you.
Bottom line. Price, location, view, area, local people and Turkish vibe give this apartment 8.5 of 10 and my recommendation.
-———
Для русскоговорящих путешественников выделю такие плюсу и минусы этой квартиры. Начну с плюсов:
1. Очень удобный и приятный район. Магазины, пекарня, фрукты и овощи все рЯдом. Просто спуститься и зайти за угол. Большой супермаркет в 15 минутах ходьбы или 5-7 минут на такси, которое обойдётся в 2-3$.
2. Район безопасный и очень колоритный. Живешь как будто в старинном городе. Все улыбаются, приветливые, отзывчивые. В одном из магазинов на улице (там где продают воду, макароны и соусы) работает русскоговорящий парень, который может дать любые советы и рекомендации, только спросите.
3. Квартира с очень просторным балконом, с которого открывается чудесный вид, так как это верхний этаж. Ночью видны высотки и огни спящего города.
4. Все рядом, в пешей доступности. До кафе и баров 10 минут ходьбы. До Галатском башни 15, до района Сутлан Ахмет 30-40 минут. Ходил каждый день пешком, ведь по дороге куча интересных мест и красивых улочек.
5. В район свободно вызывается такси через убер или их местное приложение. Цена такси от аэропорта до квартиры 130-150 лир (май 2021) или 13-15€. Ехать с аэропорта 30-40 минут.
6. Квартира подойдёт для двоих, максимум 3 путешественников. Маленькая, но уютная. Есть все, чтоб готовить еду, но кухня не рассчитана на «банкет из 20 персон». Так, сварить кашу, сделать салат, выпить кофе или чай.
Из минусов можно выделить такие:
1. Слабый интернет который часто отключается и нужно заходить заново. Немного надоедало это, но смирился.
2. Так как это крыша, последний этаж, то потолки в ванной и спальне низкие. Я с моим ростом в 187 см порой ударялся головой об углы. Но за пару дней привык.
3. Часто с канализации пахнет. Не сильно, но запах есть, так как дом старый, более 100 лет. С этим также свыкся и через пару дней даже не обращал внимание.
4. Душ довольно специфический. Вся вода льётся на пол, и после душа нужно ее убрать шваброй, всем смыв в сточную дырочку. Опять же, не привычно, но 1-2 дня и уже все нормально.
Общее впечатление 8.5 из 10. Это не отель, не люкс квартира, но это то место, где вы почувствуете настоящую Турцию, узнаёте людей, вдохнёте колорит, дух страны и местных жителей. Я очень рад путешествию и выбранному месту для жизни в Стамбуле.

description:
A historic İstanbul experience. In a 120 years old building by the seaside, built for the foreign residents with delicacy who constructed famous Haydarpaşa train station

Located at the very center of the city, the main tourist attractions are 20-25 minutes away. Any means of transport is available within walking distance

Countless cafes, galleries, bars, boutique shops, giant wall paintings nearby

reviews.text:
Location is good and the flat is spacious, however the pictures on the app are misleading and airbrushed. The condition of the electrical sockets (very dangerous), walls, ceilings, doors and furniture is terrible and the place not suitable for a comfortable family stay. The balcony advertised is a communal one and oversees directly the interior of another flat. The apartment is on the third floor and the walk up on a hot day could be exhausting especially with luggage.The place is cheap to rent, but not worth the money. I wouldn't stay again.
Demir is very responsive and speaks excellent English. I hope he takes a note out of this review as the accomodation has a great potential, but requires significant investment.

The apartment was as described and the host was very responsive. The location was very walkable. Street parking is very difficult to find but that's not the host's fault so no problem. Just wanted to mention that for future guests. Honestly it's best to just use paid parking to skip the hassle.

Amazing location, excellent value, true Turkey experience in a beautiful old house. Fully equipped for your needs. Modern renovated bathroom with hot shower. Desks for working or studying in each room with super strong stable wifi. Great for remote work and groups of friends or large families. Plenty of space! The hosts were very responsive to all requests. Thanks, Demir and friends!

The apartment is great and matches the pictures, we appreciated that there were 4 rooms which gives more privacy. The apartment is within a walking distance to the Havaist station, ferries, and all public transportation, and is in a quite area but very close to the center of kadikoy (also within walking distance).
Demir was helpful and supportive when we had some issues with heating and fixed them asap.
The only inconvenience was that the house is on the 3rd floor, which was a bit tough in carrying luggage up and down. But the apartment is also situated in a flat area, so you get to avoid carrying your luggage across any hills.
Overall the stay was great and would recommend it to anyone considering to stay in Kadikoy.

The location of the house is very good. Walking distance to Kadikoy, Moda, Bahariye. Very close to restaurants and shops. The house is nice and clean, very suitable for big groups. The downside is that the house is on the third floor and there is no elevator.
There are 4 double beds in 4 bedrooms. The rooms are spacious and every room has a small closet and a table. But the bed covers are too small for 2 people. Also there is no extra covers or blankets or towels. And when we asked for extra blankets or covers, we didn’t receive any replies; not even a negative one. That’s why I gave 4 stars.

description:
I have 11 apartments where I can host my guests. If this apartment is not available on the dates you want, please check the other apartments in my profile. You can find all the reviews about me on my profile.

My apartment is within walking distance to Istiklal Street. Thus, bus, subway etc. located in Taksim Square. you can easily reach public transportation vehicles. It is also very close to Karaköy and Beşiktaş. You can shop from stores in the street and eat and drink in cafes and restaurants

reviews.text:
We stayed at this place for 5days. It was pretty nice flat which was on 3rd floor. Had lift for access but mostly it was loaded with cleaning supplies where they used to move up and down. So we all couldn’t fit in and had to use twice. But it didn’t bother us that much. But only the problem was the toilet, as there is no window and some mold on the silicone and water was suddenly turning to hot and cold. Otherwise it was a decent place for a short stay. Place was nice as described, and easily accessible to locals. Taksim square within 10-15 mins walking distance and galatta is the same. You don’t need a car here. Fun place to walk around with all the familiar shops and restaurants.
They had QR code to book food delivery to the flat, but we didn’t use it. But they also had airport service, which was a good service. Don’t forget to keep 60 Euro in cash, as he didn’t mention us and said that the machine isn’t working when we are at airport, so we had to run for an ATM, which was a rush..

The apartment is amazing, typical the photos,
the second bedroom has the heater inside it so there’s a little bit of noise if someone used the hot water at night.
The apartment’s location is amazing ,
There’s supermarket,restaurants in the street,
5 -7 mins walk to Istiklal street and Taksim square,
10 mins walk to “Sahil” the sea.
The host replies immediately,
There’s an elevator which makes reaching the apartment easier ,
The check in and out was an easy smooth process.
We really enjoyed our time there.
I totally recommend it .

I had a wonderful stay! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location made it easy to explore Istanbul, with great restaurants and transport nearby. Communication was smooth and quick, which made check-in and check-out effortless. If I come back to Istanbul, I will definitely choose to stay here again. Highly recommended!

Thanks to the hosts for the hospitality! I liked the apartment - it is spacious, conveniently located, has an elevator, comfortable beds. We had a problem with the shower, but the host solved it in moment - he is always in the house during the day.
What could be improved: update the dishes for eating (there are only 2 cups in the apartment, one of them is cracked, the plates are cracked too), add mops and sponges for the kitchen and bathroom.
Overall, very happy with the rental!

Great host. very good location Has a decent size elevator. Hoat will receive you and help you with your luggage.
Only down side was:
1- We were a family of 4 and the apartment had 4 cups, 4 forks and no knives or cuttlery. I am sure if we asked for more he would have gotten us more. but even for one person this is not much. So if we had coffee, we would habe no cups for water.
2- there was dust on the floor as if it hasn't been mopped from the previous check out. They do have a cleaning staff so when we raised the issue they immediately sent a crew to take care if it.

description: AyRoom is located in the heart of the historical peninsula and it is within walking distance of Istanbul's many attractions; including, Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Topkapı Palace, Basilica Cistern considered important landmarks in Istanbul.

reviews.text: Wonderful location, comfortable stay. The host was very helpful, the room was as described, clean, spacious for my sister and me, the location was great for visiting old Istanbul. If you are traveling as a couple or with a friend on a budget, I would definitely recommend it. Would stay again on my next trip.

The accommodation looks better in live than on photo to be honest. We enjoyed a lot, it is very authentic, cozy, clean, super center location. Thanks to our host. He met us with flowers it was very nice of him. Appreciate his help.

We absolutely loved Emrah’s apartment, it’s been one of the best ones on our extended trip so far. The location can not be beaten, five mins walk to the square and famous mosques which was amazing day or night. The area is busy without being loud, as well as beautiful and spotlessly clean. Bed was comfortable which was a relief after a few recent stays with uncomfy beds! Although we didn’t meet Emrah personally he was always available by the Airbnb app to reply to messages quickly. Checking in was a breeze, there is a shop below the room and the employees there gave us the keys as well as let us store our bags either side of the stay... we arrived early and left on a night train so this was invaluable to us. The only thing that disappointed (and meant 4 stars instead of 5) is that the listing had “breakfast included” which it turns out was an error. We found some great buffet breakfast places opposite the building though, that were also super affordable so it wasn’t a big deal, and Emrah removed this part of the advertisement when we pointed it out, as well as apologising for the mistake which was fine by us. Thanks Emrah for a wonderful stay in Istanbul, we’d really recommend your place! Ps. A final thought... the stairs up are quite steep, so if you have mobility problems maybe message before hand to be sure it’s ok for you:-)

Really nice room, very good value for money, amazing location with close walking distance to all the main attractions! Only downside was the WiFi was pretty poor - however we were moved rooms so maybe in the listing it would be okay.

The room is nice, exactly as depicted and clean. The location is awesome - it is placed directly behind the blue mosque in the Sultanahmet district. You can reach most of the famous sights within 5min of walking. Almost connected to the room is a little restaurant where the staff was really nice and friendly. Emrah is also very nice and he answers to all questions immediately.
I can fully recommend the room.

description:
Hello 😊 Please note the following information to ensure a smooth stay:
1️⃣ Please specify the correct number of guests at the time of booking. No additional guests are allowed after confirmation. There is paid indoor parking for the car
2️⃣ Before check-in, all guests are required to share images showing their Turkish ID number or passport details for registration purposes.
3️⃣ Due to the seagull sound, you may occasionally hear the sound of seagulls from the roof. The natural habitat of seagulls in Kadıköy

reviews.text:
This place is so awesome! The apartment is bright and well planned, the view is so beautiful, especially at sunsets. Great atmosphere!
The location is good, it’s 5 minutes away from everything you might need, including restaurants, bars, markets, hookah, transport and so much more. But at the same time it’s on a very quite street. Also, this street is easily accessible by taxi, which is not always the case in Kadikoy center.
The furniture is a little aged, but it’ well maintained and clean. This place also has a really good full duplex wifi, which is rare in Istanbul hotels.
Beyazit is a great host. Very responsive and welcoming. He responds almost immediately and helps with everything. Definitely one of the best experiences I’ve had on Airbnb!

Everything in this appartment feels like a rushed job. Like the contractor, despite never having done anything of the sort, had exactly 3 hours to make an entire AirBnB. Fake foam tiles in the "kitchenette" that had no useful items in it. Shower head only attached by a single screw. Smelly toilet. Curtains don't stretch wide enough to keep the room even semi-dark after 5am. AC drain hose is connected to the balcony by a SCREW that penetrates the line causing the balcony to flood in water when the AC is on. The roof is so thin that you get woken up by the pidgeons walking over it at the break of dawn if you don't wear earplugs.
Honestly the worst appartment I've stayed in in Istanbul, by far.
On the plus side: location was great, walking distance to ferry, metro and bus, big fridge to keep your drinks cold, no noise from the street

It’s a great place that looked just like the pictures and it has a beautiful view of the water and the Europe side of Istanbul. We had the entire apartment which consists of a bedroom, bathroom and living room with a balcony all private. The only slight annoyance is the seagulls but there’s no escaping them anywhere in Istanbul I imagine especially since we were on the top floor but I didn’t mind much. Also it’s a 5 minute walk from the fairy and many busy shopping and food spots. And the host is super nice and very quick to respond through the app.

It's a great place - comfortable, clean, and the view is fantastic. The neighborhood is alive, but there's very little street noise in this particular spot. The host is friendly and helpful. Highly recommend!

you can never go wrong with this cozy apartment. it's a diamond which rare to find. best value you can find at the Moda region. there are a private balcony and full glazing at the dining room. amazing view to the Bosporus, Sultan Ahmed and Hagiah Sophia mosques, Topkapi palace. 10 minutes walk to the ferries, metro and bus stations. If you want to stay at the quite place and be step away from famous Moda street this is the best option. everything you need is very close. internet connection is stable and flies over there, good point for remote working. apartment is well heated for mid temperatures.
it's relatively high audibility at the bed room indeed, but I haven't had any problems with it at the dining room (except seagulls having their business on the roof, but it was fun overall 😅) for me all the pros overlapping all the cons.
Beyazıt Bey is very kind and super responsible person. he tried his best to fulfill our requests in the blink of an eye. I highly recommend this apartment to consider. if it is free to book, you won't be disappointed :)

description:
The space
My house is in a very central location, 10-15 minutes walking distance to Şişli Cevahir Shopping Mall, Nişantaşı, Beşiktaş, metro, metrobus, bus stops. There are many markets around me.

reviews.text:
What can I say except that I had a wonderful stay at Asli’s house !! Everything was beyond perfect : the house is close to Taksim & within walking distance of Nisantasi, one of the chicest neighborhood of Istanbul. It is spacious, clean with lots of natural lighting. The house was well equipped (washing machine, electric kettle, cuttleries, tea/coffee/cereals etc., tv, iron, great wifi connection, comfy double bed, ...). It feels literally like home and that’s what I liked the most. Asli is also such a sweet person and helpful when you need her. She has a solution to every problem. I will definitely come back again since the quality/price ratio is excellent. I forgot to mention that there is a small grocery shop (Migros) 100m away which is very convenient :)
Thanks for everything Asli ! It was a pleasure !

It was a great one week stay!
Beautiful apartment situated in a beautiful local (non touristic) area. If you're looking for a great clean european experience (both in terms of location and people living around), that's a very good choice.
everyone around (in groceries, drug stores, coffee shops) were speaking english freely.
Apartment is very spacious, clean and comfortable to live in. Every amentie you may think of is definitely 100% is present here. So it was comfortable to live in from the get go, we have had everything to feel comfortable.
Also if you're looking for the place to more stay indoor and spend much less time outside (as in our case), it was also very comfortable (pretty quite during the day, good internet connection, dunno, no issues whatsoever).
View from the apartment is gorgeous!
There is also a small cozy balcony in the kitchen.
Aslı is a very bright 🌞 and compassionate host. fast check-in. comfortable no-stress check-out. we were always in touch.
Thanks again, me and my partner we really liked staying at your apartment, it felt as if we were truly home 🌈
Aslı’s place is perfect. Just like in photos. Location is great. Flat is clean. She answered my all questions and her communication is on point. I recommend this place.

Asli is a fantastic host and person. She was very helpful, friendly, very accommodating and very quick to respond with any questions. Asli is flexible with check-in and check-out time, which was extremely helpful, all you need is just to inform in advance. The place was very clean and had all of the necessities for a stay. Asli gave us some
superb recommendations on where to eat in case we decide not to cook at home, places to shop and sights to see. Even though she was very busy, she took the time to help us out on a particular occasion.
My wife and I enjoyed her comfortable apartment, which is in the most convenient location. Her cat Mayki made our stay much more comfortable.
There are many great coffee shops, restaurants, shops in walking distance and the neighborhood itself is great and it was close to metro station (Sisli and Osmanbey) to get you to the ones further away.
This is definitely the perfect place to stay in.
We wouldn’t hesitate to stay at Asli’s home again.
Additional information about patients at different medical facilities that are deciding to stay near your medical place in Sisli:
Asli’s home is the leading place to stay in while examination and treatment!

Asli's apartment is located perfectly near everything you'd want, from groceries shops and supermarkets, through hospitals and banks, to petrol stations and even a police station. A 15 min walk gets you in the middle of Nisantasi with all of its many restaurants, bars, cafes, sweet shops and sprawling life.
The apartment feels more spacious than what's on the photos and the living room and kitchen receive a lot of sunlight during the whole day. There's a nice little terrace overlooking nearby rooftops, a great place for your morning coffee. The kitchen is equipped with everything you'd need to prep yourself a light meal and even has spices in hand. The living room has couches that are good for relaxing as well as for working on a laptop. Internet connectivity is very good. The bedroom offers a wardrobe, cupboards and a comfy double bed. Overall, you won't be missing anything at all, Asli has thought about everything, even small details like umbrellas. She's a nice person and very easy to communicate with. We had a great time in her place and we recommend it.

description: Located in the heart of Taksim Square, Deluxe Room offers modern comfort just steps away from vibrant Istiklal Street. Explore nearby cafés, restaurants, shopping malls, and art galleries. Our newly designed rooms are equipped with top amenities for a relaxing stay. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel, and an elevator provides easy access to all rooms. Whether you're here for business or leisure, Deluxe Room ensures a memorable stay in one of Istanbul's most exciting districts.

reviews.text: Host was friendly and proactive with clear instructions. The place is a short walk from Taskim square with easy access to Bus/Metro. Place and accomodation was as described in the listing and photos. Reasonable wifi. Overall happy with our stay here when visiting Istanbul.

Definitely worth the price. We complained about the ac noise in the room we were given at first but then they offered another room with a better ac instantly. Good customer service and also arranged airport transfers. Only complaint is that the housekeeping fully rearranged the things in my room even though it was cleaned well just made it difficult to locate everything.
Great value. Everything as described. Responsive host and staff.
room is located in near taxim everything is near. room is very comfortable, clean and there is everything you need. the staff is very friendly.i recomend to stay here.

We stayed for one night to rest during our long layover in Istanbul. Place was nice and well described. We arrived late at night and although their lift was not working due to electricity outages but the reception helped to take all luggage to the 3rd floor . Recommend to stay.

description:
3 bedroom and 1 living room duplex house next to Cevahir mall and metro station in Sisli area. You can go taksim, nisantası and historical places by this metro/subway.
Perfect for families, friends, or business travellers.
2 bedrooms (one has A/C)
1 large living room with comfortable seating, a TV, & a light, airy atmosphere.
1 study room with a convertible sofa(for two people).
1 bathroom.
1 large terrace with city view
5 minute walk to Sisli metro station with no hills,

reviews.text: Serkan is a great host, often asking if you need anything and if everything is going well. The room was comfortable and the common areas were well equipped and pretty clean. The location was also great, just few minutes from the metro (2 stops from Taksim) and a big mall with a good supermarket. The cats were also lovely and haven't seen any of their hair (the place was vacuumed pretty often). Would definitely stay again.

The place is very suitably located: literally 5-7 minutes to metro station and bus stops, next to the house there’s a big shopping center with grocery and other shops, also the apartment itself in a very cozy district.
The flat is very clean, it has everything you need for a comfortable staying.
Serkan is very responsible and friendly, he’s ready to help if you have any struggles, also he really cares if your stay is comfortable 🙌🏽

I like my room with very big desk, big window and hanging rack. I can put all drawing and personal materials on the desk and do stretching exercises in room.
And more importantly, host is thoughtful to guest. I feel comfortable to stay here without any worries. For example, when I asked for a good shop for scanning, he even called the printing shop to make sure it has scanning service and can speak English.
Last, the location is convenient. Very near the big mall and metro station. Taksim is just two stops away. And there is also bus to Besiktas.

I lived here for a month. If you’re also digital nomad like me, I recommend this place! There is a huge desk and enough light in the room which is really nice for wfh. Also the space is pretty big, bigger than the image on the web. There is also a nice rooftop and kitchen that you can cook whatever you want and eat at rooftop sometimes.
The host is really friendly and nice, he helped me to carry super heavy luggages upstairs, and introduced me everything, making sure I am good, and also took care of my needs.

Good location clean room and great host. I feel at home here during my stay.You can get a lot of helpful information from Serkan,and you can get well along with his cute cats.I think you would love this cozy home 🏡

description:
The duplex is on the 5th floor and has one of the best views of Istanbul. Even though you will be in the city centre, it is very quiet and calm; a great place to relax and watch the spectacular view of this ancient city, birds, sunrise and sunset form the East and West facing balconies.
There are a total of 3 levels; 1st level has 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, 2nd level has a living and kitchen area with 2 balconies and the 3rd level has a large private terrace.

reviews.text: If there is a better view of Istanbul in any other apartment in the city I’d be very surprised. The view from the 3 balconies and rooftop is the same as that from the top of the Galata tower with the extra advantage of also including the tower itself! Ok, you have to climb a winding, six floor staircase to get to the apartment which was challenging with heavy luggage, but absolutely worth it.
