The apartment itself is really well laid out with kitchen, dining and living space upstairs (including two balconies) and two bedrooms and bathrooms downstairs. It was so full of interesting books and artwork as well as a piano, (plus that view), we were reluctant to leave the apartment. Very thoughtful in terms of amenities, equipment, useful bits and bobs. Communication was seamless, helpful and flexible over timing. Location is perfect with metro 5 minutes away, tram and ferry within 10 minutes (hilly) walk. Plenty of shopping and restaurants right on the doorstep. A really wonderful place.

The views in the apartment was absolutely stunning. The apartment was very spacious and looked exactly like the photos in the listing. The host was very responsive and was very proactive in responding to questions. She was also flexible. The surrounding area had lots to do. The entire apartment was clean and had all the basic amenities you needed. It was definitely worth the money and will be returning back in the near future!

The place is as in the photos and fantastic location. The stairs are steep so consider that when booking. The host is responsive at all times. I hope that they pay extra attention to the cleanliness of the space and do maintenance around the house.

We loved our stay at Itir's place. It was so comfortable sleeping, morning breakfast, lounging upstairs and also outside when weather permitted. For its location, the quietness of the space was uneblievable. There was nothing we were missing; everything from the kitchen essentials (teas, coffee, all cookware stuff), bathroom ammenities, entertainment (wifi, TV, sound system, cables, incense sticks and candles for chilling, etc.), extra blankets, shoe polish/cleaner(!), vaccum cleaner and good assortment of reading material - it was all there. The view from all patio space was so stunning both day and night, and the proximity to everything - you actually can't ask for more. Well, you could wish for an elevator but a bit of an excersize is generaly a good thing. This space had so much personality. The wall art, plants, light fixtures, swing seat outside. It didn't feel like some sterile or artificial home with random sprinkle of decoration. We definitely recommend this place!

Amazing, is not enough to describe this apartment in the heart of Beyoglu and Galata. From the architecture, to the very well thought of artistic touches, this apartment is a heaven for someone who loves art and architecture combined with the best views of Istanbul!
Although the building is old, the apartment itself is modern and has all the amenities one would need for a stay in the city. Be aware of the 5 floor narrow spiral stairs. True it was hard to get through them with a big suitcase but the views at the end made it all worth it.
I could sit for hours on either terrace and enjoy a 360 view of Istanbul. It felt like a therapy.
Finat was an amazing host. I truly enjoyed our virtual conversations about architecture. She was very communicative and check in/check out were very easy.
The apartment was clean. I wish it had a laundry but that would be ideal for a longer stay. It was close to many sites. You can walk to Karakoy, Taksim, and Sultanahmet.
This is my 3rd time in Istanbul and this apartment is by far my favorite airbnb. I am looking forward to going back again, next time with only a carry on though 😀
Thank you Fitnat and Itir for having such a lovely home to host visitors who will definitely fall in love with Istanbul over and over again after the stay.

description: The most special room of our hotel will make your trip even more beautiful with brand new and artistic touches. Our hotel, which is only 1 minute walking distance from Taksim Istiklal Street and Sent Antuan Church, is in a very perfect location and only 6-7 minutes walking distance to Taksim square, Galata Tower, metro and trams. There are books that you can read in 4 different languages in our room, special lighting and sculpture decorations add a different ambiance to the room.

reviews.text:
I booked this place initially for 3 nights but later extended for another 4 nights. Its a perfect place rooms are good enought to accommodate no of persns you have booked. We were 5 (2 adults and 3 kids) and we lived comfortably. Management good and responsive to the needs and provided all the required necessities. The rooms have all the listed items.
Location of this place is perfect, less than 100m to the Istaklal Street, 10 minutes walk to the Sishane Metro station and 10 minutes walk to the Tophane bus station. Galata Tower is also on a walking distance maximum 10 minutes walk. Taksim squire 15 minutes walk. All the good and average restaurants are everywhere around this place including basic grocery shops where we used to buy basic stuff including fruits.
We really enjoyed our stay and it felt like home and definitely will recommend them in case you want to stay this part of the city. you can move anywhere from this place.
Once you are done historical visits to the traditional place like Blue Mosque, Aghya Sofia etc you can move to this place and you will not regret. Best value for money.
Our flight was scheduled at evening and we were supposed to checkout at 12 but they agreed ro extender our check out until 3pm which was really helpful especially when you are staying with a family.
Thanks for the great hospitality and indeed will come back to this place if I travel again to Istanbul.

It was a great layover stay and worth travelling from the airport even for one night.
Friendly and helpful staff and clean room close to the high street and the wharf - what else is needed for a short stay!

Everything was so nice about this room. The room has so nice ambiance and it's like an art room. So comfortable beds and good-new furnitures. Also host was so nice and helpful. So close to Istiklal Street. Thanks for everything.

Very central location (2 Min to istiklal street)
Response time and communication was very good
Airport transfer was organised through the owner and it worked out flawlessly
The place is very near to Taksim. We love the room so much. Comfortable and convenient…recommended to stay here.

description:
Would you like a perfect stay at the hearth of Istanbul's historic peninsula?

This booking offers a fully equipped design apartment in Taksim. Located right on the most beautiful part of the famous Istiklal Street, you will find historic places, prestigious museums, night life, public transits and more just beside you.

With a restaurant cooking delicious meals downstairs, daily cleaning service and assistance for all kinds of concierge needs, this apartment is to make your vacation memorable!

reviews.text:
Amazing location close to everything, elevator is a huuuge plus and quite rare thing for Istanbul's old buildings, beautiful interior! The apartment has everything you might need(l
coffee machine, dishwasher, iron/ironing table, set od towels and etc.) and feels like staying at high-end hotel!Mehmet is one of the most lovely hosts I've ever met, very caring and ready-to-help!
Please, be aware it can be quite noisy till very late, but you should be ready for that if you're willing to stay right at Istiklal caddesi, close to Taksim and all the main spots :)

Öncelikle ev konumu itibariyle şahane sadece gürültülü haliyle ama bu bizi rahatsız etmedi. Sakinlik istiyorsanız size pek uymayabilir. Açıklamalarda yazan otopark kapatılmış o yüzden biraz otopark sorunu olabilir valizlerle yürümek zorunda kaldık bizi tek zorlayan buydu.Eve dijital anahtarla girmek çok konforlu ve pratik bu özelliği çok sevdik. Evin temizliği, ev içi imkanlar ve anlatılan her şey söylendiği gibiydi. Gece bile çok rahat dışarı çıkıp vakit geçirdik özellikle Galata kulesini gece saatlerinde sakin ve sessiz yakalamak isterseniz tam da yeri. Sadece ev sahiplerinin mesajları biraz daha erken cevaplamasını rica edebiliriz 🙏🏾 Bir sonraki Istanbul gezimizde yine tercih edeceğiz.

great apartment. shame it is not somewhere else. noise level is horrendous, it is full on noisy until around 4am, then it starts again from 06:00. if u have to still work, this is not the place to go. u walk through a kebab shop to get in and out. the wifi is also terrible and the advertisement of netfix etc is a lie. would not recommend to anyone other than my worst enemy......
Perfect location and apartment very helpful host 10/10

My wife & I had an amazing stay at Vera’a place. The flat is modern and situated on Istiklal street in between Taksim Square and Galata Tower. We found that getting a taxi from the Ramada Hotel down the road made it easier for taxi drivers to find us as they don’t allow vehicles on Istiklal St. The area is extremely lively and there are plenty of restaurants around. The flat comes with great amenities and the host is extremely quick with her responses. I will book this place again.

description: Our apartment, which is within walking distance to Beyoğlu/Istiklal Avenue, the center of Istanbul, is a peaceful apartment where you can enjoy the view of the Golden Horn. It is a magnificent experience where you will be in the center of the city and away from the noise of the city at the same time. There is a 24-hour parking lot (ISPARK). This private apartment is perfect for your family or colleagues with 3 bedrooms. Only the living room has air conditioning. There is no air conditioning in the bedrooms. You will feel that you have enough space for everyone.

reviews.text:
As a location is very hard to find, but it has paid available parking close to the location.
photos of the locations dont show that the property need some repairs in the bathroom and one of the bedrooms ( the wall close to bathroom was wet and full of mold). The problem is with the shower than need to be fixed...water is infiltrating in the wall and floor. Because of that problem we couldnt use one bedroom and slept on that bedroom mattress places on living room floor.
The location is near shopping area (10-15 min walking distance away) and restaurants around.
The furniture in the kitchen is aged and it would really be usefull a door to the kitchen.
As per total experience it was complicated, because we were a family of 4.
Host is aware of the problems and it will probably fix it in the future.

The house was quite spacious and had a beautiful view. It was well-equipped with everything we needed, making it a great option for larger groups.
However, the cleanliness could have been better. We didn’t feel very clean overall, and a more thorough cleaning would make a big difference.
The balcony was smaller than it appears in the photos—four people could fit, but it wouldn’t comfortably accommodate more.
Although the location seems close to the center on the map, getting there is not very easy. The area is quite hilly, walking can be challenging, and the property was not very easy to find.
There was no elevator, but the stairs were short and manageable, so we were able to carry our luggage up without much difficulty. This was not a problem for us.
Overall, it was a pleasant experience:)

Our stay as a family of five for two weeks was so much fun! The apartment is near Istiklal street and the Galata tower, and the hosts were very helpful as well! They were always available and ready to answer any question and fix any issue we might have. It was easier to communicate with Benny though since he's the one who speaks three languages fluently.
The location itself was very nice and a good retreat after the busy day tours. The view from the balcony was amazing, we've spent early mornings and late evenings there. It was a bit hard to find the precise location (especially for the taxi's) and the slope next to the house was a bit challenging especially for elderly or for people with a bad knee. But we enjoyed the work out!
The apartment is close to the main road which is great for getting taxi's and close to restaurants and shops.
The apartment itself not exactly as in the pictures, the balcony and the living area were exactly the same but the kitchen needed more updating. a bit overpriced in that regard.
check-in and check-out was smooth and they were there to help us settle in.
Thank you guys and hope to see you next time we visit Istanbul.

The place was just like the photos, clean and calming. Musacan was a great host, helped us in multiple ways to make our stay comfortable.
The apartment is walking distance to Galata, Isteklal and Taksim.

This was a fantastic place to stay, with three double bedrooms and a balcony with a fantastic view. Very clean, comfortable, and in a quiet area, but easy to walk to the Nevizade area and other busy spots. Musacan was very helpful and responsive, and the place was great value for money, highly recommend

description:
One room with double bed available for short term rent in a shared apartment.
Apartment is very close to bus station.
2mins walk to closest Bus Stop
5mins walk to Halic/fener station.
20mins walk to Eminonu
20mins walk to Balat
15mins walk to Fatih Mosque.
15mins walk to Halic Metro.

reviews.text: Host is responsive and helps you whenever you have questions. Location is close to main tourist attractions. Room looks exactly like in photos. We had a pleasant stay, thanks!

I don't recommend the place at all. We took over 40 pictures of the place. Not clean , fungus corners and walls.broken filthy toilet and bathroom. Dusty. Not as advertised at all.after midnight we arrived, if we realised it when we left our luggage to get something to eat , then won’t stayed a second.honestly the first scam ever. Someone who is living there left unwashed pan and stuff in the sink. The kitchen was very filthy as well. honest to God, I can’t explain how terrible the situation of the place was. What triggers me is the response of the host who was even not there. he’s keeping saying you saw my review on Airbnb. I don’t know how on earth those people wrote this review. Even his brother ( living in the place)who seemed not aware of how his brother Abbass put it on Airbnb. if we did not have an expert driver in the area we would never find it at all.

Good value for money. Location is near tram line (although during my stay it was under construction so I had to walk a bit to the next tram/metro station). It was easy to find and I felt very safe in the neighborhood. The host replied fast and gave recommendations what to visit. I can recommend this place.
Abbas is a kind, patient, and excellent host. everything is so clean, so tidy, close to the transport station, a good host and a cozy place. You feel like home.
We had a comfortable stay for two nights. The location is pretty good for the price. There was a fan in the room which was good to have.

description: Sea view apartment on the 2nd floor of an original building in the hearth of Sile. 60 m2 large living area with kitchen, king size bed, bathroom with shower, satelite tv. sea view . Accomodate up to 4 person .Possibility short/long period rent .

reviews.text: The old lady that gave us the keys was sweet and even washed our clothes for an extra price. She was really kind. The appartment could be nice and it has an amazing location but you can tell that someone doesn’t really put in the effort to keep it clean and it misses even the most basic appliances. I bought and left a lighter there cause without it you cannot operate the gas stove, no oil or even salt/pepper… the bathroom is where the real trouble starts - the toilet doesnt really flush and the shower is mounted in the wall (?) plus the floor is a bit disgusting there. All over the flat the floor is dirty and the carpet full of sand and dirt. We are used to walk barefoot or with socks at home, so this was a big bummer for us. As you can see from the pictures the furniture is like 70s ish and it also doesnt receive much care from the owners when it comes to cleaning.. Overall it was nice there but I wouldnt stay more than like 2 nights…

Tumay was a wonderful host and warmly welcomed us upon arrival. The apartment was clean and the kitchen had plenty of cookware and dishes. It would be great to have some basic condiments like cooking oil, salt and pepper available. We loved the spectacular view from the balcony and living room. The location was excellent. Very easy to walk around to some nice restaurants and cute shops which were all close by. The single extra bed was a bit hard though. My son didn’t sleep very well. Otherwise everything else was great.

Tümay was the perfect airbnb host. He happened to be in Istanbul on the day we arrived an offered us a lift back to Sile. We chatted about Turkey and he was very friendly and welcoming. The apartment itself is in an amazing location 4 minutes from the main strip and a 15 minute walk to the beach. As others have said the apartment is very basic but very clean. I think the kitchen could have done with a few more amenities (maybe a bottle opener). The balcony was a gorgeous space to have breakfast and drinks on. He answered all of our questions and made us feel very welcome. Highly recommend for the personal touch and the location.

Tümay was a wonderful host! He helped us out a lot beforehand with how to get to Sile and once we got there it was really easy to find the apartment, which was very spacious and had everything one could possibly need when travelling (nice shower, kitchen with some supplies, comfortable beds). The balcony had a beautiful view over the Black Sea (it was only 5 minutes walking to the nearest by beach). Not only did we get a nice apartment, but Tümay also showed us around town, gave us very tasty watermelon after an afternoon on the beach and brought us to the farmer’s market, where we were warmly welcomed (with lots of food). Sile is relatively close by Istanbul and thus a perfect addition to your stay there, if you want to get away from the busy city life for a couple of days and enjoy some beach.

The view from the balcony is amazing. The apartment is a good size for 2-3 people and the kitchen has some basic cooking utensils (which we didn’t use because we just wanted to explore around and eat at all the nearby restaurants). The location is great - it’s a quick walk to a small beach or a 15-20 min walk to the bigger beaches with sun beds and umbrella rentals. The closest restaurant (Hemdem) is about a 1 min walk from the apartment and has amazing food. The host was friendly and helpful, always quick to respond. They also helped order us a taxi to Istanbul the day we checked out, which was really helpful (Sile doesn’t have Uber and even Uber is just a taxi service in Turkey, it’s not third party drivers). We loved our trip in Sile and would stay here again!

description: Located in the heart of Beyoğlu is a fantastic building. You will be a short distance from İstiklal Street, public transportation, restaurants, markets, bakeries, historical landmarks and everything else Istanbul has to offer! Enjoy this newly renovated home that we furnished with our guests in mind!

reviews.text:
What we liked : location, clean bathrooms and hot water, functional kitchen, good neighbourhood. Close enough to taksim that we could go shopping anytime. Host is responsive.
We couldn’t use the basement room to sleep because of the smell, it was only used for storing luggage; bed broken on the ground floor, relative had to sleep on the floor for the duration of our stay because they couldn’t climb stairs; AC didn’t work well on the first floor so we had to keep the door open. Non functional ground floor AC was fixed within a day.
I hope they change the beds and mattresses and install ACs in the basement so it’s a better stay for other guests but for us it was an ok experience, location makes it worth it.

We stayed here for two weeks and overall had a good experience. The house feels warm and homey, with a well-equipped kitchen, clean linens and bathrooms, AC in every bedroom, and a comfortable dining area that was great for our group. The owners, Tuncay and Halit, were very responsive, and Tuncay quickly came to fix an issue we had. The location is excellent, with many attractions such as Istiklal Street, Galata Tower, Galataport, and Taksim Square within walking distance.
The main downside is the steep stairs and hilly streets, which can be challenging for families with babies or elderly guests. The building is also quite old, and we noticed some humidity, especially in the basement, and unfortunately saw two cockroaches during our stay.
Overall, a friendly and comfortable place with a great location. We appreciated the hospitality and would recommend it, especially for younger groups. I wish 4.5 stars were an option!
Thank you, Tuncay and Halit, for your hospitality.

It’s a big place and can easily fit 8 people. Close to shopping district.
There is a one bedroom in the basement that is musty. We tried opening the windows to let air in but the outside smelled bad so that wasn’t an option.
Unfortunately when we were there the roof started leaking bad from the heavy rain. The water was on the staircase and made it slippery. The staircase doesn’t have railing but it is wide. That’s still dangerous.
There wasn’t much the host could do as he said the issue was external and they had to repair it on a dry day.
The location is close to a main shopping street but the neighborhood is sketchy.

We had a great stay at the rental home in Istanbul. Everything matched the photos, and the cooling system was excellent. The location was very convenient — close to Istiklal Street and Galata Tower. With a short walk, we could reach a shopping mall.
However, it wasn’t mentioned that the streets around the house are quite steep, and there’s a noticeable uphill walk from the main street to the property.
Communication with the host was very easy. Every time we sent a message, we got a reply within five minutes.
Overall, I would recommend this place to others as long as they don’t mind stairs and steep streets.

The apartment was spacious for all 9 adults - it was clean with lots of clean linen and towels. The washing machine and dryer were really new and super functional. The kitchen was well stocked up and came complete with pots and pans!
The neighborhood was quiet and made up of lots of friendly locals. There is a mosque diagonally opposite with a little grocery shop beside it so extremely convenient.
Location-wise, it was a bearable 7-mins walk to Istikal Street though it's not the most convenient as you had to walk under the bridge and it was rather quiet at night. But since we were travelling in a big all-adults group, it was absolutely ok but we still had to be cautious.
Overall, it was a lovely experience staying here. The host was very responsive and even offered us to check out anytime during the day when we requested for 1 hour of extension.

description: My flat is located at BESIKTAS, it is a quiet and safe neighbourhood. There are also lots of cctv. It is only 400m away from the BESIKTAS pier, 3 km away from ISTIKLAL Street, TAKSIM. There is a building including 3 flours that we have 5 flats.

reviews.text:
Stay away from this place. It operates more as a hostel with private rooms than any type of apart-hotel or apartment building. It's got creepy staff also. I have no idea how this place has so many positive reviews. I got refunded in full immediately and found a much better place a mile-and-a-half away in Sisli.
Some of the greatest hits of my experience:
-Creepy af staff. You feel it immediately.
-Listing has no washer as advertised.
-When confronted with the misrepresentation of his listing, because I needed to wash my stuff, the host (Kerem, who does not speak English) showed up with two other men and yelled profanities at me (in Turkish of course, which I don't speak with any level of fluency, but I am nevertheless more than familiar with many of the most well-known curses, don't ask why lol). His colleagues had to actively calm him down and tell him to stop.
-Super-noisy location, which is expected in many areas of Besiktas, but this place is especially bad, and I've stayed in Besiktas long-term multiple times. There is a cafe downstairs, which is cool and convenient especially for us over-caffeinated types, but combined with the ambient street noise, it is bad. And I was there all of maybe two hours.
-Can't overstate the hostel like atmosphere, which is fine, but for me, I'm not of hostel age anymore, and these aren't hostel prices.
-The room is absolutely minuscule. Digital phone photography sure does work wonders. The build
-Kerem did not respond to a request for WiFi info. It took two other people and twenty minutes of waiting in the cafe to get me connected.
-Fellow travelers, don't say you didn't know, cause I just told you.

This apartment to me is at the most convenient area of Istanbul, not very touristic but full of modern local lifestyles. You can find everything you need around neighborhood and it’s very easy to reach public transportations. Even just by walking you can go many nice places. The landlord is very helpful always asking what you need through WhatsApp and get things fixed immediately. The room is at 3rd floor there is no elevator but the landlord helped me to carry up my suitcase. They clean the room every 2 days with new bed sheets and towels. If there is few things I might not very satisfied is there isn’t washing machine in the apartment as it says on the pages, I was planning to wash my clothes after a week traveling in south turkey but I couldn’t in the end. Anyway the landlord can bring your laundry to somewhere else. And if they can change the bed sheets bit new and better quality, the towels bit bigger this place would be perfect for one or two people. Compare with location this apartment is very price worthy and I will definitely come back.

Check in was very smooth. They were there as soon as my taxi arrived to help with my luggage and show me the apartment and connect me to WiFi on all my devices. Throughout my stay they constantly checked on me to see when and if the room needed cleaning or if I needed anything. The apartment is exactly as described and everything worked perfectly. I loved loved loved the location. You can walk to Dolmabahce Palace, the mall and lots of restaurants. Do not hesitate to book.

The room is exactly as it's described! Great location in Beşiktaş, and even though it's so close to all the bars and restaurants it's so quite at nights!
Room was clean and the communication with Kerem was so easy and he was so helpful the whole time.
I will come back here again :)

I did a reservation for a studio to Kerem but i didn't have at all the same experience than the others airbnb's users in this apartment.
It's true that this apartment has a great situation (very close from the center of Besiktas very active and full of life but hopefully in a little street more quiet) and Kerem is a very nice host (he answers very fast and try to make your stay comfortable).
Unfortunately, the apartment wasn't great.
In the first we tried, there was an awful smell of cigarette smoke in the entire apartment (even if it was clearly written on the ad that it was no smoking), the shower didn't work and the audio isolation wasn't good.
I wrote to Kerem and he answered and came very quickly. He proposed us another apartment for the next night and we accepted.
It was better in the other apartment but still a lot of little problems so we decided to leave cause it wasn't possible to stay for us. Too much problems in only 2 nights.

description:
The world's favorite, in the heart of Istanbul: Our apartment in Kadıköy...

Kadıköy metro, ferry piers, bus and minibus stops,
It is only a five-minute walk to the new Istanbul and Sabiha Gökçen airport shuttles, and a ten-minute walk to Söğütlüçeşme metrobus, Marmaray and Ayrılıkçeşmesi metro, Marmaray stations...

It is in an excellent location where you can easily reach many parts of Istanbul without any traffic problems...

reviews.text:
I don't know how to say thank you with him.
Tamer is good person, friendly and really helpful. Even me as solo traveller, he really understand with my situation. he gave alternative itinerary for my short trip.
His apartment is really closed to Kadikoy bus station and ferry terminal. If you want to stay in Kadikoy, I suggest his apartment is highly recommended. The room is very clean and comfortable 👍👍👍

Tamer's apartment is in a great location, close to many things including buses, metro, and ferries. Tamer is a great host who is adept at using a translation app if he doesn't speak your language. he does understand more English than he gives himself credit for. a great variety of food is available in the area for a very reasonable price, so I only used the kitchen a couple of times. I spent two months in the apartment and already miss it! Riding the ferries every day is a treat you won't get many other places. Thank you, Tamer for the opportunity and for your wonderful hospitality!

Gercekten her şey belirtildigi gibiydi eksigi yok fazlası vardı ki bu da Tamer Bey' in inanılmaz misafirperverliği, kibarlığı ve cana yakınlığıdır. Kadıköydeki konumu itibariyle toplu tasimalara olan yakınlığı sayesinde ulaşım oldukça rahat. Oda temiz ve kış aylarında oldukça sıcak. Banyosu ve tuvaleti tertemiz hiç rahatsızlık yaşamadım. Fiyatına göre gerçekten çok iyi bir tercih olacaktır. Tavsiye ediyorum.

Host is super super kind person.
Room is good enough, that has single bed, desk, and sofa etc. It looks small in the picture, but not so small. It has window also and you can open, and can get sun shine short time though.
Public area is generally small. Kitchen is small but enough, but no living room.
In this listing, you can see three rooms' photos. One of them will be reserved for you.

If I want to describe it in one word, I would say it was Amazing!! Tamer is a great person that you should meet if you come to Istanbul .... he is really helpful and he treated me like his little brother ... even he helped me with the luggage when I was moving in, and out ... he doesn't care about the language barrier he tries his best using Translate app to communicate ... the location of the house is great and you can reach public transportation easily ... Tamer guided me to use the airport bus instead of the taxi (since the taxi is more expensive) and helped me as well to reach the bus, and he stayed with me till I left .... Thank you so much Tamer for your kindness and for accepting me as a guest at your lovely house ... I really enjoyed the experience at your place and it was a pleasure to meet such a kind and caring person like you ... you made my trip amazing and of course I will visit you again when I come back to Istanbul. this is definitely my best Airbnb experience 😍♥️

description:
The Apartment, which is a new renovated historical building, is located in the Beyoglu and Taksim area, which is also a historical district of ​​Istanbul.
The Apartment is 5 minutes' walk from Istiklal Street, bars, traditional restaurants. It is also very close to the most important historical places such as Eminonu, Sultanahmet and Galata.
It is 2 minutes away from the Markets, Bakery, and fresh food bazaar which is available every Sunday.
It is a 9-minute walk from underground paid parking.

reviews.text:
I stayed a few nights in this apartment which is located very close to Istiklal street. There are many amenities and restaurants around, basically all you need is a very close distance.
The apartment looks like in photos, but you need to consider that it’s in a basement so it’s a bit dark and a bit smelly. After using A/C the smell went away but not completely. It is well equipped and everything is provided (towels, water, cups, etc). The apartment door was a bit hard to open and close but ok. Other than that, communication with Ömer was good and he gave very clear instructions on how to check in. That was very easy.
Overall, good value for money.

We stayed in the apartment as a couple for one week.
Here a short overview of our experiences:
Good:
- apartment well equipped with everything you need
- apartment looked like on the photos
- very comfortable bed
- nice big shower
- cozy living room with SmartTV
- Omer was very kind and responded quickly
- lots of stores / restaurants nearby
50/50:
- backyard little dirty, people drop their trash there
- apartment half in the basement -> little dark
- gas stove needs a lighter to be ignited
- washing machine louder than jet engine (don't start at night)
- Netflix, Disney+ etc. on SmartTV, but didn't work -> TV asks for update, although no updates could be found
Bad:
- apartment door was damaged with a hole -> lack of privacy
- bedroom door couldn't be closed -> door didn't fit into the frame
- lots of mould in the bathroom -> bathroom has no exhaust air shaft
- lots of little moths
Thanks for the nice stay, Omer! :)

Very convenient location. The owner responds very quickly, always helps. The apartment has everything you need for life - washing machine, iron, kitchen utensils. It is worth considering that the apartment is located on the - 1st floor and there is very little natural light in it, according to the photo it is not entirely clear. Otherwise, the price-quality ratio is excellent! Thank you!

Omer was a great host, very fast communication! 2 small grocery stores 3 minute walk, restaurants 2-3 minute walk and a good bakery a few doors down from the grocery store! 10 mins to main shopping street. Quite neighbourhood just outside the tourist area. The apartment is a good size the bed is very comfortable the shower pressure and temperature was great! Also the air conditioner is amazing and wifi is good!
Would stay again! Thank you!!

öncelikle ev sahibi Ömer beye ilgi ve alakası için çok teşekkür ederim kaldığım sürece evin temizliği olsun konumu olsun çok memnun kaldım ve çok rahat ettim tekrar tekrar cok teşekkür ederim Ömer bey

description:
Apartment 5 is respectively called “Deluxe 5″ with a amazing seaview from the Marmara sea,
and has 85 m2 of space, 2 bedrooms (one with 1 double bed, one with 2 single beds), living room with 2 sofas (one of the sofas opens up to be a large double bed), kitchen, bathroom and balcony.

*_I would suggest every guest to let me know right away regarding their time of arrival, Also please be reminded that there is no elevator in the the building. _*

reviews.text:
I can not say enough about this awesome apartment. First of all the pictures do it justice. The view is exactly as you see it, with amazing sunrises and sunsets. The apartment is exceptionally clean and bright. Our host had wine and fruit waiting for is upon our arrival. The contact and connection with Ugur, our host, was exceptional, he set up airport pick up for our arrival from the U.S.A. We were so grateful for that as it was a long flight and we were tired! He also was most helpful about any information we needed or questions that we had and was quick to answer any texts or calls.
The neighborhood is wonderful if you are staying in Old Istanbul. Easy (although a bit hilly) walk to awesome restaurants, and the major historical sights. My husband and I like to walk so we only took the tram one time (which was super easy as well). Across the street is a market selling essentials as well as delicious fresh vegetables.
About the apartment....
1. Super clean and bright
2. Awesome views from the balcony, which is quite large!
3. Great washing machine. (There is no dryer, but there is a clothes hanger which is perfect.
There is also a great hair dryer as well.
4. The living room/common area is a good size space, I was able to lay out my yoga mat and stretch with plenty of room.
5. The bathroom is large, as is the shower, very clean, with ample towels, and the hot water is AMAZING, as well as the force of the shower!
6. The beds are super comfortable. Firm enough, but not too firm. Ample pillows and blankets.
7. Ample amount of outlets, and the windows open easily.
8. The apartment is 3 flight s up lovely marble stairs. There is no lift, but as we ate a lot of amazing food and desserts while we were here, walking up the stairs was perfectly fine with us. 😊
9. The cleaning woman was precious and came every other day to clean, and make beds,etc. We were there for two weeks , so she also changed the sheets after the first week!
10. There is one flight up from the apartment, a roof top terrace with ample space, tables and chairs, as well as a few comfy lounge chairs, with self serve tea and coffee available all of the time. The views from here are spectacular!!
11. Oh and I feel I need to add this, the neighborhood felt, and was very safe. A true neighborhood, with families, and school children, and local shops and eateries. Walking around all of Istanbul, I never once felt unsafe. Everyone was extremely kind, and gracious, and generous, so if you’re on the fence about going to Istanbul, then go ahead and take the plunge! You won’t regret it!
If you are looking for the perfect apartment, in terms of space, view, location to public transportation, as well as the major sights in the old town, with an awesome host who is ready to help you in any way he can, for a great price, then you should definitely stay here! My husband and I are already thinking about returning next year as we loved the people, food and sights of Istanbul, and would like to explore this region more, using this apartment as a home base.
Enjoy!
Elise Faust

This apartment is an excellent base for exploring Istanbul. 5 minutes’ walk from the Blue Mosque in one direction, 10 minutes’ walk from the Grand Bazaar in another, 5 minutes from the fish restaurant area of Kumkapı in a third, the location makes it easy. The apartment is just what it looks like from the photos, very light, with a view of the Sea of Marmara from the living room/ kitchen and from the roof deck one floor above. Kitchen is equipped with the basics, plenty to make our own breakfast (buy Turkish coffee!) but enough to cook meals too. Very clean when we arrived, and a cleaner comes every other day. Beds are comfortable. An air conditioning unit in the living room kept the bedrooms reasonably cool, but be sure to close curtains during the day to keep the apartment from heating up. Ugur was very accommodating, and he arranged our travel to and from the airport as well as our luggage storage after we checked out. He was especially helpful on the phone when we were confused about where to meet our ride. He also provided advice for where to find shops in the area. The apartment on the 4th floor and there is no elevator, so be prepared to climb the stairs, but the view any time of day is worth it.

Our trip to Istanbul was amazing, it was our first time in the city and everything was perfect. The booking of this apartment was very late due to another Airbnb host cancelling last minute. From the very first time I contacted Ugur (our host), he was very polite and informative. When we arrived at the airport he had arranged for us to be picked up and taken to the apartment. As soon as we got there, Ugur was waiting for us even though it was very late due to our flight being delayed and then being held up by Turkish immigration.

Ugur was very organised and knew how to be the perfect host. He had provided us with a turkish mobile phone with credit, tram and bus cards, map of the city, fresh fruit, coffee, tea, milk, water etc. Ugur also provided free transfer from the airport. This was very nice of him and was complete unexpected, he defiantly went above and beyond our expectations to ensure we have a comfortable stay.

The apartment is just as good as shown in the pictures, if not better. Contrary to google maps, it is actually a lot closer to the main sites (it only took us around 3 minutes to walk to the blue mosque). The apartment was very clean and tidy and house keeping was provided once every two days. Towels were also provided and changed when house keeping came.

The neighbourhood is nice and quite in the evenings but still within a couple of minutes walk to shops and restaurants. There is a very friendly connivance store opposite the apartment which pretty much sells everything.

Check out was at 11am, but Ugur still gave us more time to ensure we was not rushing and was comfortable.

All in all, it was a very comfortable stay which was made better by the host, we could not have asked for a better experience. If I ever go back to Istanbul I will defiantly be staying at this apartment again!

We loved our stay at Yüksel’s apartment in Istanbul’s lovely Sultanahmet. We are 4: two parents, a teenager, and a grandmother.
The view out the living room/kitchen windows (+lovely balcony) is as amazing as in the pictures! We loved planning our days, having a cup of tea, and cooking breakfasts and some dinners while looking out over the Sea of Marmara. My 78 year old mom felt that the view was more than worth the flights of stairs. :) The kitchen is quite adequately appointed for a family of four to do basic cooking.
The location cannot be beat! Easy walk to Aya Sophia, Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace, etc. Very short walk, although up a steep hill, to the Çemberlitas tram - from which we went everywhere! Lots of restaurants and shops nearby, particularly the small but excellent market across the street.
Most importantly, the host was exceptionally responsive! He arranged airport transfers, met us at arrival, shared transit card, answered texts at all hours, and was SO nice!

This is the perfect spot for tourists to stay in Istanbul. The apartment has a great view and the space is extremely well used and a family of4 has enough space for a longer stay. Everything works, hot water, kitchen, internet, ac is strong enough for whole apartment. there is some minor wear and tear. there are smaller grocery stores very close, and larger ones 5 minute walk. ugur takes care of the place and is very helpful snd responsive. if you you have mobility issues: the area is hilly and stairs are steep.

description:
If you stay in this centrally located place, you will be close to everything as a family. You can reach the sea by walking 300 meters. The family apartment is a calm and peaceful place. There is a Marmaray line passing in front of us, and using this, you can easily reach the most beautiful places to visit in Istanbul
(Sultanahmet, Hagia Sophia, Taksim, Üsküdar, Fatih, Beyoğlu). ISTMARINA SHOPPING MALL is also 1 km away. To summarize, it is a friendly and reliable place where you can easily access all kinds of facilities.

reviews.text: The place was nice and clean, the garden was lovely, a lot of cats, they was cute, no internet connection during our stay, only one towel, I recommended it fit better for two persons but after all I think it’s worth the paid, the host is nice and responsive.

Die Kommunikation sowie der Check-in und Check-out verlief sehr angenehm. Mahmut hat mich persönlich empfangen und mir auch beim Gepäck geholfen. Es gab eine kurze Einweisung in die Wohnung. Der Internetanschluss ist sehr gut.
Bei Fragen oder besonderen Anliegen konnte ich Mahmut immer fragen.
Zum Apartment muss ich sagen, dass man alles da hat was man zum Leben braucht. Ideal für 1-2 Personen.
Die Gegend ist ruhig und man erreicht die Busstation in wenigen Minuten zu Fuss. Die Marmaray kann man innerhalb paar Minuten mit einer Busfahrt erreichen oder knapp 10 Minunten laufen. Drum herum gibts genügend Supermärkte, sodass man auch am späten Abend noch einkaufen gehen kann. Die Küste ist auch sehr nah, sodass man am Abend beim Sonnenuntergang einen schönen Spaziergang machen kann :)

Çok rahat, temiz! hava harika! ve deniz yakındadır. İstanbul'da yaşadığımız en iyi konaklama. Herkese tavsiye ederim! Очень уютно, чисто! воздух супер! и море рядом. самое лучшее жилье из всех что мы жили в Стамбуле. Всем рекомендую!

We had a very pleasent stay, the apartment is exactly how it looks when you see it on air bnb. Mahmut helped us with all the questions and the neighbours are sweet and friendly. The Wifi is really good and in the kitchen you find everything you need. The area is pretty safe, close to the ocean and in the middle of the green garden feels like you have a little jungle apartment.

Very beautiful garden. Unfortunately there were some ants and spiders which were bothering us, as well as some mosquitos and flies entering through the nets. When we arrived there were already a tremendous amount of fruit flies in the kitchen. Still, if you don't mind it may be worth it for the nice garden.

description: This is the house at the centre of Cihangir which is considered the home for artist, international people. You can easily find any kind of food, bakery, art galleries, transportations within 10 min walk. Taksim(İstiklal) is 5 min away too. And the town is quite safe so you can walk 24/7. We are 2 min away from you in case of any need. The building has a lift, and it is quite brand new so the furniture are brand new too. We do run airbnb in the building so you will have fun to stay here

reviews.text:
The house is in a great location, close to many cafés and restaurants, and within a short walking distance of Taksim Square.
Vicky, who looks after the apartment, is an amazing host—very responsive, extremely polite, and always helpful. He deserves a 10 star rate.
Overall, the stay was very good, but there are a few minor points worth mentioning.
During our stay, construction was taking place directly opposite the apartment, which caused noticeable noise from around 9am.
Additionally, the bathroom is located right behind the larger bedroom, and there appears to be a water pump or similar system that makes quite a loud noise whenever the toilet is used, which can be disruptive for anyone sleeping in that room.
Lastly, the smaller bedroom could benefit from a small wardrobe and a mirror.
Overal I would recommend this place and would stay there again if I visit Istanbul again.

The flat was exactly as shown in the pictures—clean, comfortable, and equipped with everything you need. Vicky was the most attentive host I’ve ever experienced. From helping us with our luggage, offering a flexible check-in, assisting with airport transportation, and always greeting us with the warmest smile, he truly went above and beyond. The apartment is located in the beautiful neighborhood of Cihangir, surrounded by great restaurants and a charming local vibe. It is situated on a hill, so be prepared for a bit of an uphill walk—but it’s absolutely manageable and well worth it. We will definitely stay here again!

This airbnb is clean, quiet, safe, great convenient location for tourists, walk to shops and all services, 7 minutes downhill walk to Tophane tramway and Galata port.
The street the apartment is located on is narrow, due to fully packed cars parked all over the curb side, taxi can still go thru it.
The 3 separate Air conditioning units in each of the rooms, washer, refrigerator, cooking stove all worked great.
The two bed mattress are old but the bed sheets are clean. The shower towels and bathrooms are clean.
The apartment and its furniture are outdated and needs renovation.
Expect 5 minutes of steep Uphill walk to the apartment building (for me it was a great daily cardio exercise).
During my 19 nights stay, electric power provider company cut off power service 5-6 times (affected entire street not just this airbnb building) each lasted 1-2 hours before restored.
The ceiling in the master bedroom leaked water from upper floor, but host fixed it after a few days.

A home away from home! This apartment allowed us to easily explore Istanbul and also feel at home in the neighbourhood of Cihangir. Deniz is a very responsive and accommodating host. His apartment is clean and very well located. It is situated on a quiet residential street, yet it is 2 minutes away from many cafés, restaurants and bakeries. Many services are available nearby which made our stay very comfortable. Istiklal street is around 10 minutes away on foot and Tophane tram station. A very minor recommendation would be to add more kitchen utensils and table lights. However, all in all we highly recommend this place!

Great spot in Cihangir for groups and/or folks looking to stay a little longer. The location is great being central to Taksim and Karakoy + transport options to the main sights across the Golden Horn or Kadikoy on the Asian side while still being quite peaceful (note that as of Apr. 2026, construction was happening next door though they only really start around 10 AM).
The place itself is spacious, clean, and well-stocked, making it also great for medium-term remote work. Beds are comfortable (though run on the softer side) and rooms warm enough during the early spring months. There is an elevator in the building as well though note the surrounding area is quite hilly.
The true star of this place however is Vicky who actually resides in the building. From a very late check-in due to a late arriving flight from Kapadokya, to coming within minutes to reset the TV, to even helping with luggage when we checked out, Vicky was what made this a 5-star stay.

description: Relax with the whole family at this peaceful place to stay. It’s central and safe Basaksehir area. So many cafes&restaurants available within minutes. Indoor closed parking garage available upon request.

reviews.text:
The appartment is clean, nice and dog-friendly.
Two of us stayed for 1 month.
There are lots of cafes on the ground floor and near the building: good for chilling in the evening
The building is new and nice
The floor to ceiling windows make the space feel bigger and lighter.
Air conditioner!
There are lots of cafe, lounges, shisha within walking distance as well as places to get groceries.
We were not familiar with Istambul, didn't realise it's a more religious neighborhood, different from the more European side of the city
Make sure you're okay with couch sleeping (matras only for 1 person). The sleeping arrangement was clear in the ad, so wasn't a surprise, should be fine for a shorter stay, but we are on the taller side, so a month of sleeping on couches might've been too long).
The shower is small, which is in line with this being a studio, but we're on the taller side, so had to be careful.
There were some car noises and beeps as the road is near.
We had a great stay overall with our dog, and the parking spot was very convinient for our car.
Great value for the price.

Yaklaşık 3.5 ay konakladım. Ev bölgedeki en iyi konumdaydı. Ulaşım araçlarına uygun ve birçok ihtiyacınızı karşılayacağınız yerlere yakındı. Ev içi gayette resimlerdeki gibi. Ancak mutfak gereçleri temiz değildi. Bu yüzden yeni tabak, çatal vs aldım. Ev sahibine söylediğimde yeterince temiz olduğunu söylediği için bundan dolayı sorun oldu. Aynı zamanda televizyon çalışmıyor. Yenisini yollayacağını söyledi ama göndermedi. Banyo güzel. Duşakabin su doluyor ve etrafı ıslatıyordu, ilgilenmesi için bir adam gelecekti ama gelmedi. Çok işlek bir yerde bulunduğu için sürekli araç gürültüsü vardı. Ama ev sahibi hızlı cevap veriyordu. Kalınabilir ama uzun süre olduğunu düşünmüyorum.

This room was on the 9th floor with amazing views. Doorman was 24/7. Also all necessities such as soaps for shower and washing machine were there, towels, blankets, microwave, oven all new. Comfort is def the focus here for up to 4 guests. Surrounded by local restaurants with super friendly locals and shops. The area is also kid friendly with many gaming/internet lounges for kids to enjoy. TV and internet with free Wi-Fi is available for work and play. I would highly recommend to book this place and I would definitely book again. The host was responsive and would go above and beyond to make sure my time here was comfortable for me and my family. His attention to me and my guests was exceptional. We felt just at home and the host is within reach over the phone. Travel around Istanbul was super convenient with available travel resources very close to each other. This is a prime location because it also close to the airport.

This airbnb exceeded any and all expectations we had before going. The apartment was clean & very spacious for a studio.
There’s a very comfortable bed (Queens size), couch, tv, dining table, silverware… basically everything I need it was there.
The check-in was very simple. The receptionists by the lobby speak Russian & English which made it easier for us to ask questions.
The most important but not least there’s AC, & not every Airbnbs’ in Istanbul have it.
And another amazing thing was that there’s a washing machine in the unit which made it convenient for our stay.
The location is absolutely prime!! It’s a walking distance to the restaurants & cafes. There’s the biggest mall (mall of Istanbul) nearby which makes it absolutely convenient.
I would definitely rebook this apartment for sure. Highly recommend it to everyone!

It was my first time in Istanbul and it was quite good.
Apartments located far away from the center is cosy neighborhood. There are many restaurants and cafes just in few steps from the house. You can catch bus that goes directly to the center so location is good. Also if you have a car - there is underground parking for it.
Bulent is very friendly and always glad to help. Apartment was quite cleaned and in good condition.

description: Welcome to our gorgeous 1 Bedroom apartment in the heart of Galata! This recently renovated apartment offers top notch amenities, and a 60 sqm rooftop terrace looking over the Bosphorus! This roof will make you feel like you are in the Garden of Eden, as you are surrounded with olive and lemon trees, listening to the singing seagulls. The apartment is located in a very central location, 30 seconds away from Istiklal Avenue subway station, and only 5 mins walk to Galata Tower.

reviews.text: This place is a gem! I absolutely loved it and feel bad not giving it a full 5 stars but we had some issues with the water while we were there. Apparently there was an outage while we were there and we didn't have water one of the days for a few hours. Also the water was not consistent, cold and hot, while showering. Oh and the dish washer didn't work. Other than this, everything was wonderful. The place is CLEAN, which is a huge plus for me. The host was super attentive and kind. The location is perfect. The apartment is quiet. The view upstairs is pretty. I would definitely stay here again in a heartbeat.

This is literally the best Airbnb I have stayed in Istanbul and I come several times a year. The apartment exceeds the pictures, is wonderfully decorated and incredibly comfortable. Combine that with fast wifi, amazing rooftop terrace, all the cooking And cleaning supplies you need and you can’t go wrong. They were so incredibly helpful and responsive to any issue. I literally have not encountered this level of hospitality in Istanbul. They went above and beyond. Thank you for an amazing stay!

Incredible location for an Istanbul stay, close to key areas but not in a totally touristy street. Apartment is lovely with wonderful views from the roof terrace, up one more flight of stairs from the apartment door. Very quiet at night and a comfortable bed and shower. Only negatives were the ongoing construction next door during the day, the regular appearance of numerous ants (all food needs to be in sealed containers or in the fridge), and the strong smell of chemical or adhesive (also throughout the stairwell). With so many restaurants to eat out, cooking was not essential and there was ample reason to be out during the day. Overall a very nice place to stay.

This was an amazing spot! The airbnb was spacious, very clean, comfortable, and had the perfect location! Theres lovely cafes, small shops all around, and it’s a quick walk to the tram! The host was responsive, friendly, and they stocked the fridge with water for us :) we’d definitely stay there again, 10/10

Great location in terms of proximity to main attractions in the Taksim area. short walk to all major mass transit. All kinds of shops, grocery and restaurants near by. Location is on a steep cobble stone street. Apartment is on 4th floor, no elevators and a steep, narrow, spiral staircase. It was somewhat of a challenge to two large pieces of luggage up the stairs but it was fine. The apartment would be a good size for two people. The place is bright and came with all required towels, toiletries, kitchen utensils, blankets etc. The place could use some black out curtains because once the sun comes up, the entire apartment is brightly lit and not ideal if you want to sleep in. The AC and wifi was good. The shared rooftop terrace has a beautiful view of istanbul and the bosphorus straight. Overall good stay, clean, quiet place.

description: If you stay at this place, which is centrally located, you will be close to everything. The islands and the sea view apartment. Walking distance to Marmaray Kazlicesme station. 2min walk to bus station and grocery stores. Walking distance to the historical samatya square food dungeons

reviews.text: Had a lovely stay at Orbay's apartment, the location was perfect, not in the middle of all the hustle and bustle but with the metro just a few minutes away it was easy to travel to different parts of Istanbul. the apartment shows little signs of wear and tear but it was clean, the kitchen had everything we needed. Orbay left us some water and also slippers which was lovely. There's quite a few winding stairs leading up to the apartment which wasn't a problem for us and was worth it for the beautiful view from the terrace which we often sat. check in was easy. Just a short walking distance there are plenty of shops and places to eat, would definitely recommend this apartment and would stay again when I return to Istanbul. Thank you Orbay for great communication and a lovely stay ❤️

The first thing to say about the apartment is that is up 4 stories of steep stairs, there is no elevator. So if you have mobility issues then I would not recommend this place. Entry was easy with a keypad on the outside and a lockbox with keys for the door. The apartment is bigger than it looks in the photos. It was spotlessly clean with all amenities provided. (Towels, bed linen, iron and ironing board, crockery etc) Some bottled water was left in the fridge for us and there are some dishwasher tablets and washing up liquid in the cupboards. There is A/C in the living room and in the bedroom so the apartment was always a comfortable temperature . There is flat screen TV that has apps for Amazon Prime, Netflix etc. You just need your passwords to get TV in your own language.
There is a rooftop terrace which is fantastic for sitting watching the ships coming and going, we found it very relaxing with a coffee early in the morning
Orbay is a nice guy and I recommend his apartment.

Great stay! The apartment has a beautiful view over Marmaray and is in a perfect location. It was clean, comfy and exactly as described. Orbay was a great host - friendly and responsive. Highly recommended!

We had a fantastic time visiting Istanbul and staying at Orbay's beautiful apartment. He was there to meet us when we arrived by taxi from the airport, he showed us around and confirmed all the amenities and WiFi. The apartment is very well equipped, everything that you need, and the spacious lounge is beautiful with an amazing sea view! Everywhere was clean, there were plenty of towels and linen, and the shower in the bathroom was quite powerful and there was plenty of hot water. Orbay also had a water dispenser in the kitchen so there was no need to buy bottled water. The rooftop terrace was amazing! Great to relax outside space with an incredible view. We were easily able to get right into the center of Istanbul to view all the sites within about 15 mins, by using the public bus service which was efficient, ran frequently and was cheap. There are two different buses, either the 80T or the BN1 depending on which part of the city you wanted to visit. We highly recommend staying here!

We are from Russia, we were in Istanbul for the first time. Our eyes immediately fell on Orbey, or rather on his apartments. Judging by the photo, they were all cozy and well-equipped for a comfortable stay. Arriving at the place (by the way, at 03:30, for which special thanks to Orbay), we were pleasantly surprised by the warm welcome of the owner and the full compliance of the apartment with the description. The location is very convenient. Orbay told/showed everything (through an interpreter of course😀👍), metro, buses, shops. By the way, late in the evening we had a small breakdown - they wrote to Orbey, he arrived in the morning and fixed everything without questions or complaints. In general, we will recommend to friends. Thanks Orbay! 🤝

description:
The perfect place for tourists to enjoy the fully Istanbul Experience!
Luxurious stay just beside Taksim square, in a fancy building including all the building facilities from gym, pool, sauna & much more!
The building is like a Hotel, very well designed, with a beautiful reception area & 24/7 Security.

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay and truly felt at home throughout our visit. The apartment is in a great location—close enough to Taksim Square (about a 15–20 minute walk), yet far enough away to enjoy some peace and quiet instead of the crowds. There are also convenient public transport stops nearby, making it easy to get around the city.
One of our favorite little discoveries was The Local Gurme, a fantastic brunch spot located right downstairs in the building. The secure parking, 24/7 security, and guarded residential complex made us feel safe and comfortable at all times. We also really enjoyed the clean swimming pool and fitness center.
What made this stay truly special, however, was the host. Whenever we needed anything, they were always there to help. Their communication was fast, thoughtful, and genuinely caring. We are incredibly grateful for the kindness, understanding, and human approach they showed us throughout our stay. It’s rare to meet hosts who care so much about their guest
The host, location and place were excellent and everything that was described I would sincerely recommend it.

The location is excellent and very convenient for getting around Istanbul. The building itself is modern and well maintained, with great facilities including a gym, pool, sauna, and steam room which were a really nice addition during the stay.
There is also a shop located on the ground floor inside the building which is very convenient for picking up essentials. The reception staff were friendly and the building felt secure throughout the stay.
The host and management team were also very responsive with communication and always offered assistance whenever needed.
Overall a comfortable place to stay with good amenities and a great location.

this airbnb is absolutely incredible your like at home in your own apartment we came as a couple you do your own thing in your own time, i would highly recomened it not bad for a price as compared to hotel you pay the same price but you get only a room , here all in one from bedrooms to kitchen and spacious shower room and toilet, you also get security for the building for your safety and lastly great area nice and quiet compared to taksim were it was all noisy all night everyday

Çok saygılı efendiler'di, su ısıtıcısı bozuldu ertesi gün yenisini gönderdiler. Arada sırada soruyorlar bir eksiğiniz varmı diye. Konum olarak çok iyi yerde taksime 15 20 dk yürüme mesafesinde ordan metroya heryere ulaşabiliyorsunuz. Sadece yatak benim belimi agriti normalde benim belimde sorun yoktu. Ilk defa 2 3 gün üst üste belim ağrıdı. Ben 20 gün kaldım memnunum dediğim gibi herşey süperdi 5 yıldızı hak ediyorlar
Negatief yönleri şunlardı:
Tuvalet Musluğu ve banyo 2 3 gün sonra yavaş yavaş tıkanmaya başladı bunu onlara söyledim ve dedilerki muslukçu gönderelim mi? bende dışarıda olacağım için gerek duymadım çünkü 1 2 gün sonra gidiyorum, yani ne sorunla karşılaştığımda iletişime girdiğimde anında çözüm buluyorlar hemen sorunun gidermeye çalışıyorlar hizmet çok iyi.

description:
Welcome to a great stay at this fully equipped and chic 1-bedroom apt. in a newly renovated historical building furnished with new and high-quality furniture for your comfort in Galata. This building faces the historical tourist attraction of Galata Tower and centrally located next to major tourist attractions.

It has every basic amenity that you will need and is designed to make you feel "Your sweet home away from home" from the moment you step-in.

Wish you experience a wonderful stay HERE !

reviews.text:
The description is 100% accurate, so I won't repeat what everyone can look up there. The hosts were very responsive, friendly and always ready to help with any of our questions. The location is literally across the street from Galata Tower, which is a buzzing neighborhood with tons of shops, restaurants and tourists. Do note that because it is one of the busiest tourists parts of Istanbul, most restaurants will have inflated prices compared to, say, Asian side of the city. The street noise only dies downs around 3am, which is not a problem if you keep the windows closed, as they block almost all the noise. However, if you prefer to sleep with windows open (e.g. to get fresh air in), be prepared to use ear plugs.
It is also very easy to get to any other part of the city via public transportation - tram lines, metro and ferries are all 5-10 minutes away on foot.
There is also a great bakery downstairs with a roof terrace featuring great views.

The apartment has a great location and a spacious layout. The host was wonderful and very accommodating. However, there were some major issues. The bed was extremely uncomfortable and made a lot of noise with every movement. The kitchen is inside the living room and had a strong, unpleasant sewer smell. The bathroom was a nightmare the water temperature kept fluctuating between extremely hot and freezing cold, making it impossible to take a proper shower. Unfortunately, these issues made the stay quite uncomfortable

Tevfik & Cagil are incredibly great hosts, I cannot give them a higher regard. The apartment was spotlessly clean, fresh sheets, towels, and they even decorated the bedroom for us upon request! When we first walked in we were greeted with a bouquet of flowers, local chocolates and a bottle of wine. The apartment was fresh, clean and was equipped with all the amenities that anyone could need!
The location is absolutely perfect, right outside the Galata tower, walking distance from all the local tourist sites and transport.
Unfortunately during our stay we had to cancel a further trip due to an emergency which required a longer stay in Istanbul and we didn’t have anywhere booked. Cagil the co host worked tirelessly to secure us accomodation eventhough all her properties had been fully booked and secured us an extra night in the property and further accommodation at a different property which was just as beautiful!
100% recommend these hosts and thank you for an amazing stay!

The room and the location is wonderful. The communication was good, but there were missing some basic things like standard kitchen equipment i would expect from a flat at this price point. The wifi connection was also bad. Anyways a good a safe place to stay in a touristic place.

This place felt like home right in front of the bustling galata tower .
Hands down the best location in Istanbul .
Squeaky clean apartment with minimalistic modern furniture.
Super friendly host who were very friendly and very accommodating.
Will be coming back for sure

description: The streets adjacent to Nomad Hostel Karaköy have been rapidly “hipsterized”; art galleries, cafes, bars and restaurants have created a new synthesis with traditional venues. With a lot of street art, these narrow streets

reviews.text: This is the first time I stayed in a hostel in Istanbul, and it was a really good decision. Barkin was responsive and greeted me at the door for check-in. He was helpful and friendly. The location was very accessible and close to the ferries, cafes, historic sites, good food, a grocery store, and public transportation! The neighborhood felt very safe, touristy, and lively. It can be a bit loud at night due to the late night life so bring earbuds/earplugs. Other positive things regarding the stay were that there were lockers in the room to lock belongings in, the bunked beds had curtains, and the bed was very comfortable. Unfortunately, there is only 1 female toilet and 2 showers so plan ahead if the hostel is full. Besides that, I had a great 1-night stay and would recommend or return! Great deal and cleanliness for the value. Thanks Barkin!

Like everyone else has said, absolutely ideal location. Super clean hostel, bed was bigger than a single and it had a big shower and always a clean bathroom. Music from downstairs restaurants can be heard until midnight ish but wasn’t a bother. Self checkin was super easy. I’d definitely recommend. Thank you!

Good things about the hostel: Perfect location, easy to find, 5 min walk from tram station. Easy access with code to the building. New furniture, modern design, comfortable rooms and beds, locks in the room. Nice big showers and toilets, clean and cool...
Bad things about the hostel: No lounge or sitting area, no relaxing area, no kitchen, there is only bedrooms and bathrooms nothing else there. The hostel is at so noisy area. Many bars around hostel, so loud music until 5-6 am so I had no chance to sleep ...

Really a nice hostel, super convenient location with lots of cafe, restaurants nearby. Well organized, clean and spacious space for travelers . Btw, the second I stayed in the hostel, there was an electricity problem in their hostel, so it was very hot in the room. Except this, everything was good

Yataklardaki perdeler sayesinde rahat hissettim. Odayı paylaştığım insanlar da sessiz ve anlayışlıydı. Aynı odayı yabancılarla paylaşmaktan korkanların kesinlikle korkmaları gereken bir şey yok. Ev sahibinin talimatları oldukça açık ve netti. Gönül rahatlığı ile burada kalabilirsiniz.

description:
Features AIR-COND rooms, a garden,free WiFi and a terrace.Situated 2.6 km from historical peninsula, 1.7 km from Istiklal Street and Galata Tower,1.2 km Spice Bazaar. We offers room service, a 24-hour front desk.

All rooms are fitted with a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, fridge,a kettle,a private bathroom,free toiletries,a wardrobe,a hairdryer and bed linen.

Istanbul Airport, 38 km from Mates Port Hotel.S.A.W. Airport

You can cominicate with us from mobile too for your questions.

reviews.text:
The place was very clean, looked exactly as the photos.
The host was very sweet and also helped us bring our luggage up the stairs.
I would definitely come back here
Abdürrahim bey ile hızlı iletişim güzeldi. Oda fotoğraflarda gösterildiğinden bir tık daha küçük olmasına rağmen gayet düzenli ve temizdi. Konum olarak da semtin tam merkezindeydi ulaşımı rahattı.

Abdurrahim’s room was excellent A+++ felt like I was staying at my own tiny home. Had a comfortable spacious loft bedroom with a working desk. WiFi was reliable and room came with neat useful amenities like blow dryer, iron, slippers, teapot with tea and coffee selection, plenty of towels and toiletries. The location was very convenient, walking distance from attractions, restaurants, and coffee shops. Great deal for the price, would definitely stay here again when I visit Istanbul again!
Pertectly located to visit as a tourist, is close to docks and tram stations so very easy to get around. The room is as is listed; clean and very comfortable. Great hosts and cleaning service!

We were just happy to stay here: excellent location in Karaköy, plenty of nice cafes and close to all noted Istanbul places. But despite this the hotel is located on a very quiet street, we slept well. Very clean and cosy room. And the hotel team is so friendly and helpful! Always in touch and ready to help with anything, including calling a taxi in a very early morning, like 4 AM. We are very appreciative! We highly recommend this hotel!

description: One of the highest and most prestigious residential complexes, the height of the floor is 4 meters, an apartment furnished with new furniture and electrical appliances that have not been used before (hotel apartment) on the 37th floor with a wonderful view of the Marmara Sea and Kucukcekmece Lake. It is located in a complex with two swimming pools + children's playground and basketball court + family seating + Wi-Fi. It is located in a very lively area with a shopping center in the city (City Center, Marmara Park, Torium) + Erdogan Park + Esenyurt Municipality + Restaurants + Cafes + BBQ Garden + Bim, Shok + A 101 + Metrobus Station 5 minutes walk + Tourist Buses + Grand Mosque.

reviews.text: Very nice apartment and great view! Highly recommend to stay here, it was very nice place and friendly host. Free parking is available, many restaurants and shops near this place. Easy to find this place because this is one of the tallest buildings on the district.
Ev sahibi güleryüzlü çok güzel bir insan.Ev kullanışlı ve temiz.Evin manzarası süper herşey cok güzeldi.Heryere ulaşım kolay. Bir daha gelicem :)
He was a gracious kind host really welcoming and very helpful
Great kitchen American style lovely flat and amenities! Definitely beautiful unit

Sehr Schöne Apart Wohnung: Neue Möbel, Seht bequemer Bett/Saubere Wäsche, Gut ausgestattete Küche. Bad Gross und angenehm. Die Aussicht war unebschreiblich. Einfach Weltklasse: Die Anlage wird 24 Stunden überwacht von Secuitys: Umgebung möglichkeiten zu Einkaufen, Cafes, Kino: Ich hatte Wochenaufenthalt, für längere sowie auch kürzere Zeit jeden zum empfehlen: Mohaned war immer gut erreichbar und hat sehr schnell immer reagiert.. Danke

description: Our apartments are distinguished by the spacious area suitable for family residence, as it contains all the necessary necessities for a comfortable and happy stay, where you feel as if you are in your own home. We also have a 24/24 reception desk to secure the needs of guests at any time, and the entire building contains a security system and cameras that work around the clock In addition to the availability of the Internet throughout the hotel, also the apartments have amazing city view

reviews.text:
We spent 8 nights here with my family from France. The flat was quite large; rooms were spacious. They provided us the parking in front of the hotel for our big car. It was amazing! We used metro when we did not want to deal with Istanbul traffic jam. It was very convenient. Location is great; there are nice boulangeries around. They also provide cleaning every 3 days. It was great service. We felt like home, everybody was kind and helpful.
We definitely plan to come back. Thanks for your great hospitality Hexa Team!

Hexa suit de konaklamam muhteşem bir deneyimdi !
Konum harika şehrin tam göbeğin de, istediğiniz saatte herşeye ulaşabilirsiniz. Muhteşem dizayn edilmiş ve her detay düşünülmüş. Temizlik konusun da obsesiflik derecesin de hassasımdır ben hiç kusur bulamadım, yataklar, mutfak ve banyo tertemizdi. Herşeyden önemlisi çok cana yakın ve samimi bir işletme. Her saatte yardımcı oluyorlar bütün sorulara anında cevap veriyorlar. Şiddetle tavsiye ederim !

The place was okay for sleeping, but there were some things that could definitely be improved. The owner of the apartment was quite cold and not very welcoming, which gave us a negative first impression. However, the staff were very kind and helpful, which we really appreciated.
There were also some issues in the apartment. The toilets didn’t work properly, and the kitchen was missing some basic items that are usually needed for cooking or eating.
Another issue was the noise. The rooms were not well soundproofed, and we could hear a lot from the other rooms, especially at night – it was often very loud.
Overall, it was okay if you just need a place to sleep, but the experience could be much better with a few improvements.
Temiz, konumu güzel, fotoğraflardaki gibi bir yerdi. Dairede olan 1-2 ufak problemi çalışanlar hemen çözdüler.

Great stay if travelling with family. Daytime receptionist was really helpful nice, responsive and helped with airport transportation. The area is quite, 10 min walk from osmenbey metro and 2-3 mins from a bus stop as well. There are a few different food options as well. Overall would recommend!

description:
The space
This room is on the second floor of a double storey flat in the heart of Kadıköy, In front of the room there is the splendid view of old İstanbul and you can open your eyes to this view. When the weather allows you can also have your breakfast at the terrace as well. There is a bathroom on your floor and guests can also use the kitchen and the living room (with a fireplace) downstairs.

Situated on the Anatolian (Asian) side of Istanbul Kadıköy is the biggest district on this side, very close to everything; cinemas, restaurants, bars, churches, mosques, High Streets and local food markets. And my flat is just in the middle of a High Street on 6th floor. When you go upstairs (yes, there is an elevator) you are completely detached from the crowd downstairs and it is such a relief!

The bed you see in the photo can easily be converted into a comfortable double bed. The price is only for person.


The room which is also su

reviews.text:
The terrace is quite picturesque, a view with your cigarette is always a plus. The room was clean and tidy, and the beds comfortable.

*I don't think anyone should stay at the european side of istanbul, take the ferry and go there but live in kadikoy.*

The location is in a central part of kadikoy on a street which you can do all your shopping on and as soon as you exit it, you have more pubs than you can count. On it and around it also countless restaurants and coffee shops. The ferry, metro and bus station on one corner, fenerbahce stadium on the other and gorgeous Moda on the third, and you are in the middle of all of it. And as if all this wasn't enough ingredients for a great vacation, there's a vintage looking tram that passes right in front of the building every 30 mins or so.

Great place, great host, great location.

I loved staying in Handan's house. The vibe here is warm & welcoming and feels like family. Handan is helpful and kind and lovely to chat with and I was always happy when she was home. The kitchen is great if you want to do any cooking. The neighborhood is lovely and very walkable. There are so many great cafes and restaurants all around. The streets have a buzzing local feel but up in the room it's completely quiet except for the occasional sound of the seagulls. The room is basic and clean and opens up to the terrace which is incredible. There is one full bathroom shared between 4 bedrooms, but there is also a half bathroom, so it was never a problem the entire time I was there (2 weeks). This was basically my ideal airbnb home sharing experience. I always felt good coming home.

You will enjoy a lovely bed in a large room that has a great view. The apartment is on the 6th floor and then up another flight of stairs. You are sharing the bath with others but that is no problem. The host and other renters are friendly and helpful. It is 10-15 minutes walk to the Kadikoy buses and ferries. You will pass hundreds of cafes, shops and ATMs on your way. Fewer people speak English in this part of Istanbul--that is part of its charm! Handen and the others will help you!
