Handan's hospitality and the central location of her home in Kadikoy was a very good combination for Asian Istanbul travel. The home is comfortable with large soft chairs and sofas for relaxing. The terrace gives sweeping views of the marina at Kadikoy. Only a 15 minute walk to the metro and ferry terminals. Handan is quite willing to chat about past, present, and future of Turkey. She is a professor of English language and fluent in English. Handan helped in every part of my Kadikoy experience from arrival to local transportation options. The only difficulty for me was sharing one bathroom with several guests in four bedrooms. Otherwise I would rate home at the top of the type of Airbnb travel I enjoy. Handan was a most gracious host.

Loved the stay at Handans place. She is a great host and heir flat is located at the center of the most interesting district in Istanbul at the moment. Forget about Taksim and visit Kadiköy. On top of that you got a great view over the Bosporus and all of Istanbul from the terrace. The accommodation itself is very tidy and comfortable for two people. Handan is very open minded and will tell you all you want to know about the city, turkish culture or her favorite spots in town. So don't let this chance go to waste.

description: Discover Istanbul from our bright, family-friendly retreat in the historic OLD CITY! Comfortably sleeping 4, this apartment is a walker's paradise, just steps from major attractions. Features a private bedroom, kitchenette, and modern decor with large arched windows. Immerse yourself in the city's rich culture from this perfect home base.

reviews.text: Shower pipe was broken and there was a leak under the sink but we reported these and the host fixed them. It was a little tricky to find the exact location as there were lots of hotels/airbnbs very nearby, however we eventually found it and the host we extremely helpful. Overall a great place to stay, clean and as advertised and a great price and location.

Everything was great overall. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and well equipped. It had everything we needed, including shampoo, hand soap, tissues, and a well-equipped kitchen.
The location was also very convenient, with many restaurants, cafés, shops, and markets nearby.
The only thing that could be improved was communication with the host, as responses were sometimes a little slow. Other than that, we had a very comfortable stay and enjoyed our time there.

Bülent place is the cleanest Airbnb we have stayed in, the towels, sheets and comforters smells really good. When you turn on the air conditioner you feel a clean air coming out. Him and his brother are very helpful and they answer really fast. They helped us with our luggages and coordinate a van to the airport that gave us better price and comfort than if we get an uber. The location is amazing, many restaurants near the house and walking distance to Grand Bazar, Mezquita Azul and many other places. The neighborhood is a mix of tourists and local people and you get to know their culture better by being there. I will definitely come back to his place.

The host was very quick to respond to my requests. The majority of items were clean, all the features listed were easily accessible. The walk to the main tourist attractions from the location is moderately far but not bad; Basics and main toiletries were provided at the place. The only slight issue was the construction happening next to the apartment - Despite it being not in control by the host, it was annoying in the mornings. The plumbing on some sanitary fixtures (toilet, sink and showerheads) were a little flimsy, but they were up to par. The host is very understanding and even let me stay longer than the check-out time to wait for our airport shuttle (as he arranged both rides for us). In conclusion, the apartment was a great deal and our experience with the host amplified our positive opinion of it.

Very good property located very close to most attractions around sultanahmet area.
Host was responsive and helped us with checkin. Apartment is spacious and very clean.
It had all amenities we needed for a comfortable family stay. We were family of 4 and had no issues with space.
We also got a very good deal for airport drop. It was cheaper and better than Uber.
Highly Recommend

description:
In order to offer our guests an unforgettable accommodation experience, we have restored a 130-year-old historical building in a stylish and comfortable way. We look forward to telling you the story of this beautiful building as we serve you coffee in our garden.

Attention: the floors and ceilings of our building are wooden and there may be sound passages between floors. Our building is suitable for those who prefer a peaceful stay and is not suitable for parties and events.

reviews.text:
Had an overall good stay. Engin is a great host - very responsive, very attentive and concerned with the well-being of his guests. The house is located in a lovely neighbourhood filled with Cafes, Restaurants etc. It has clearly been renovated with a great eye for detail. The room and bathroom were spotless clean at arrival with many helpful items provided. Internet is fast as well throughout the house. Despite the age of the house, the noise level was absolutely acceptable.
A small word of warning though: The room did get very hot given there was neither a fan nor AC, and the backyard appeared to attract many mosquitoes so leaving the windows open at night turned out to be problematic as well. If you are sensitive to heat and you're visiting when the daily peak temperature exceeds ~26 degrees, it might be worth checking with Engin beforehand.

For me, one of the main criteria in rented housing is cleanliness. The Engin guest house is very clean. It should be understood that the house is old and some windows and doors do not close well enough, but I was not cold, despite the fact that I visited Istanbul during the coldest period. There was a kettle, tea and a bottle of water in my room. There is a refrigerator on each floor. The house has a garden, which, unfortunately, I could not use because of the snowfall. The house itself is in a great location: very close to bahariye, but on a quiet street. There is a parking lot opposite the house. Engin was very caring and helpful. I will definitely come back.

Değerli Engin her şey için çok teşekkürler.Her şey belirtildiği gibiydi fazlası vardı hatta.6 numaralı odada fotoğraftan fazla olarak 1 tekli koltuk ve puf mevcuttu.Balkonun manzarası şahane.Ihtiyacınız olabilecek her şey mevcut ve temiz.Girişte ilgiyle bizi karşıladı,gerekli noktaları anlattı.Rezervasyon öncesi,varış,çıkışta iletişimi güzeldi.Ara ara durumumuzu sordu.Bu iyiydi açıkçası kendimizi evimizde hissetmemiz için elinden geleni yapmaya hazır bir ev sahibiydi.Konumu Bahariye caddesine 100 metre bile değildir :) Biz memnun kaldık.Rezervasyonumuz son dakikaya kaldı.Farklı zamanlarda diğer odaları da denemek istiyoruz.Oda küçük olduğundan dolayı yatak da küçük fakat bunu fotoğraflarda açıkça belirtmiş.Bununla beraber yatak küçük olduğu için oraya uyan herhangi bir yatak seçilmiş biz evde yumuşak bir yatak kullandığımız için sadece bu konuda zorlandık.Fakat diğer odalarda böyle bir durum olmadığını söyledi.Tekrar teşekkürler Engin tekrar konaklamak isteriz :)

I stayed for almost 5 nights at 2 different rooms of Engin’s place, and it was amazing!
The place was perfectly located in a safe and vibrant neighborhood with great access to metro, shops, bars and restaurants.
Engin was a great host. He welcomed me, helped me with the luggages and communicated about essentials during my stay.
I also got sick for a day and he took care of me and offered an herbal tea, which helped a lot.
Everything in the room was clean and just as described by the host.
I loved my stay here, will come here again, and I would definitely recommend it to anyone visiting Istanbul, specifically in Kadikoy (it’s a great neighborhood).

Engin is a wonderful host. I had a bit of a problem during my stay and he was more than eager to help me, thank you so much again! The room is facing the garden with lots of trees, allowing for calmness and freshness after a day in the urban labyrinth that is Istanbul. Everything was just like on the photos and spotlessly clean. The house is beautiful and carefully restaurated. One of the few houses remaining from the Ottoman era in this part of Kadıköy.
It‘s just a little bit off the pedestrian main street, so it‘s rather calm while still being near to any place you‘d want to go to as well as to the ferryboats and Marmaray. I highly recommend staying there!

description: Welcome to our beautiful bright Galata home tucked away by the mesmerizing gorgeous famous touristic Galata Tower! Our beautiful home is situated in the heart of Galata! Close to all the tourist attractions, coffee shops and restaurants. Comes with a fully equipped kitchen, two modern bathrooms and 2 spacious bedrooms. Enjoy a dining table for friends and family to gather around. A spacious living room with Netflix and Wifi. Comes with A/C. The perfect home away from home for you to enjoy!

reviews.text:
This flat is located on the first floor of the building super close to Galata tower. It seems that it has been refurbished recently while still keeping its old character!
Pros: Its location is great. You are literally 1 minute walking distance from Galata tower and surrounded by cafés and restaurants! The flat was clean and equipped with most of the things that you need. Beds were comfortable and towels and beddings were really clean. Two bathrooms had very hot water with great pressure.
The host -VNG Team- was impressively responsive! I asked them many questions and all my messages were answered within a few minutes!
Cons: only bedrooms have AC, so despite having a pleasant temperature in bedrooms, corridor and living room were really hot! - we stayed there in August
Windows were not easy to open at all and elderly people might struggle to open them. A minor thing: probably it will be helpful to have trash bin in bedrooms.
Overall we enjoyed our stay and I will recommend this flat!

Clean comfortable place that matched the description. Vast rooms full of light during the daytime and not cluttered. All appliances worked fine, beds were comfortable, and water pressure in the bathrooms was great. Although the kitchen had everything we needed, it was on the smallish side for a long-term stay. But who need to cook in Istanbul when you have the best affordable kebabs just outside your door. Host was very responsive and replied almost instantly. Location is supreme with 2-minute walk to the Genoese Galata Tower and half way between the bridges, the old city, and hilltop Istiklal/Taksim. We highly recommend this place and would stay again on our next visit to this historic city, if available. Thank you for everything.

Exactly as described, this was an excellent base for a tourist visit to Istanbul. We were a group of 4 but there was also a sofabed if you want to squash more in. Small but equipped kitchen - we only made tea or coffee. Clean and tidy apartment on the first floor. The Galata tower area has lots going on but a walk (if you don't mind the odd hill), tram ride, metro or taxi can take you in all directions. Grocery stores nearby open until midnight and cafes start opening from about 8am. The apartment had recently been refurbished and two door handles broke - one, on a bathroom door, was fixed after two days, the other, on a bedroom door, was not fixed but we were able to wedge the door closed with a pair of socks . Not a disaster but not brilliant either and the reason for 4 stars not 5. Would happily stay there again.

We had a lovely time in Istanbul – it’s now high on our holiday list. The property is in a fantastic location on the European side, with a superstore on the doorstep, and great coffee, breakfast spots, and kebab shops just a short walk away. Istiklal Street is a 15-20 minute walk, and the tram and ferry access is excellent. The property itself is spacious, clean, and quiet (despite in middle of Istanbul), with only minor issues like a slightly broken latch on the shower. The neighbours were incredibly helpful – they assisted us in contacting the property owner when we forgot our phone in the car and offered us to wait in their home. Overall, a highly recommended property for its location, comfort, and great hospitality.

Very central location, one street away from Galata tower. Despite that, very quiet street so there is no noise from the outside if you are sensitive to that.
Communication was fast and easy, newly furnished and the apartment was very clean.
Only downside is that one of the bathrooms had quite a lot of mold around the shower area, if one is more sensitive to that.

description: Have fun with the whole family at this stylish place.

reviews.text: Konum olarak mükemmel,her yere yakın(metro yakın), bir kaç adım mesafe de tüm ihtiyaçlarınızı temin edebiliyorsunuz. Ev oldukça geniş ve aydınlık. Ev sahipleri ilgili ama rahatsız etmemek için siz istemediğiniz sürece görünmüyorlar. Bolca havlu ve yedek nevresim daire de mevcuttu. Eksik birşey der isem mutfak ekipmanı belki daha fazla olabilirdi,kapsül kahve makinesi olsa iyi olurdu. Sonuç olarak bir daha ki seyahatim de ilk tercihim olacak yer burası. Fiyat/performans olarak çok iyi.

Ev sahibimiz mesajlarımıza ve isteklerimize hızlı, kibar şekilde döndü. Yer metroya ve otobüs duraklarına yakın, yemek yenilecek yerler de var. Ayrıca daire içerisinde de mutfak temiz, gerekebilecek şeyler de sağlanmıştı. Fazladan havlu, yastık yorgan olması da çok iyiydi. Temiz, sakin ve güzel bir konaklama geçirdik! :-)
Ev sahibimizin iletişimi, evin temizliği ve dizaynı, evdeki imkanlar olsun her şey harikaydı. Muhteşem keyifli bir konaklama yaşadık. Tekrardan teşekkürler.

Fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibi ve temizdi. Konum olarak iyi bir lokasyondaydı. Tek sıkıntı 4 kişilik bir daire için yeterli miktarda tuvalet kağıdı bırakılmamıştı, istediğimizde resepsiyondaki arkadaş bir tane daha verdi.
Very nice apartment, in a good location walkable from the main streets. Hosts are very kind and helpful and always available. I will choose this apartment again.

description: Explore historic Istanbul from this modern 1-bedroom apartment, just steps from the sea. Perfectly located for sightseeing, it comfortably sleeps 4 guests. Enjoy a private retreat with AC in each room and walk to iconic landmarks like the Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque in just 15 minutes. Your ideal base for discovering the city's heart.

reviews.text:
Excellent stay!! Perfect location
Ahmet and Sevgi were Super hosts!! Loved Istanbul so much that we stayed an extra week and Manager Ahmet came down to change our booking and done it on the spot. Loved the way it was dealt ever so thankful to Ahmet and Sevgi,
Ahmet and Sevgi you guys were amazing, a member of the team helped carry luggage from street to flat, fabulous flat, mini kitchen, Ac’s, nice bathroom we were four of us, stairs up to the apartment, very clean, exactly as in pics, minute down the road it’s a street full of restaurants, cafes, never ending shopping street, barbers, butchers, affordable shops in the area, 5 mins walk to historic church , 2 mins from kumkapi train station, 5 mins to the sea shore (Sahil),15 mins walk to Blue mosque, Hagia Sophia, grand bazar depending which route you take, changed the bedsheets and towels during our stay. We would love to come back, definitely deserve a 5 star 🌟
Thank you for our good memories already planning to come back soon.

The place was clean, identical to photos, and with all amenities listed. Host was friendly and communicative. Definitely worth stay.
The bus station is 5 minute walk and train station (Beyazit Kapalicarsi) is 15 min up hill walk. There are a lot of restaurants around and few markets.

The stay was simply amazing! Apartment was exactly as described, very clean and comfortable. I was really stunned by the location. You can walk to every attraction and beautiful, traditional restaurants, bars are on the same street. Cengiz was very helpful and super responsive. I would definitely recommend it and will definitely stay here again! Really amazing and beautiful stay!

This stay was a major disappointment and far from what was promised in the listing. From the moment I arrived, it was clear that the photos were misleading — the apartment looked nothing like what was advertised.
The bathroom was in terrible condition, with a strong damp smell and mould covering parts of the walls and ceiling. It felt unhealthy and completely unacceptable. The washing machine didn’t work, the iron was rusted and broken, and the kitchen was missing essential furniture — it felt like the place hadn’t been properly maintained in a long time.
The towels provided were shockingly old, thin, and fraying — definitely not what you’d expect from a place claiming to offer comfort. On top of all that, I was charged an inflated price for airport transfer, only to discover that local companies offered the exact same service for half the price. I felt taken advantage of.
This was not just a case of minor issues — it was a completely different experience than what was advertised.

The place was very good. Clean, comfortable and easily accessible to Sultanahmet (10 mins walk). Really enjoyed my stay, only issue was that the WiFi was slow, and the bathroom sometimes had a weird smell; if not, everything was perfect.

reviews.text: Bu konaklamayı özellikle jakuzili olduğu belirtilen oda olduğu için daha yüksek bir ücret ödeyerek tuttuk. Ancak odaya girdiğimiz andan itibaren sorunlar başladı. Jakuzi çalışmıyordu ve ev sahibi nasıl çalıştığını bilmediğini, usta bulunmadığını söyledi. Buna rağmen herhangi bir ücret indirimi veya telafi sunulmadı.Temizlik kabul edilemez durumdaydı. Yatak çarşafları yoğun şekilde insan kılıyla kaplıydı. Değişim talep etmemize rağmen gönderilen ikinci ve üçüncü çarşaflar da aynı şekilde kirliydi. Jakuzi içinde ve odanın birçok yerinde kıl vardı. Odada hamam böcekleri, kirli kettle, tozlu eşyalar ve çekmeyen Wi-Fi mevcuttu.Sorunları yazılı ve görsellerle iletmemize rağmen ev sahibi odaya gelip inceleme yapmadı, temizlik veya onarım için çözüm sunmadı. Vaat edilen hizmetler sağlanmadı ve hijyen standartları yoktu. Hayal kırıklığı yaratan bir konaklama, kesinlikle önermiyoruz. Bozuk bir jakuzi ve kıl dolu çarşaflara aldıkları bunca parayı helal etmediğimiz bilinsin, aklı olan da gitmesin.

Bulut bey ve diğer çalışma arkadaşları son derece nazik güler yüzlü hizmet anlayışıyla karşıladılar ve konaklamamız sürecinde her konuda eksiksiz ve açıklayıcı yaklaşımda bulundular. Merkezî konumda bulunan yerimizde bir çok restorant AVM eğlence merkezi olanakları mevcut olup istediğimiz her yere yürü mesafesi uzaklığındaydı. Konaklama yaptığımız dairemiz ise görseller ile birebir aynı hatta genişlik olarak daha geniş ferah temiz tamamen ev konforundaydı. Oda sıcaklığı har daim mevcut jakuzi amacına uygun genişlikte ve temizdi ayrıca konaklama alanlarında pek mümkün olmayan su sıcaklığı durumunda içiniz ferah olsun her daim sıcak suyumuz mevcuttu. İsletme ve çalışanları için daha çok olumlu düşünceler belirtmek mümkün yapmış olduğum en iyi konaklama diyebilirim gönül rahatlığıyla tercih edebilirsiniz herşey için tekrardan teşekkür ederim Bulut ve ekibini sevgilerimle
Daha öncede konaklamıştım. Temiz, rahat, iyi iletişim, iyi konum.
Fotoğrafta göründüğü gibiydi jakuzi sorunsuz çalışıyor ısıtma sistemi güzel çalışıyor yatak konforlu ve temizdi ayrıca akıllı televizyon var güzel bir deneyimdi.

Mehmet bey iletişim noktasında çok sıcakkanlı ve yardımseverdi. Jakuzi sorunsuz çalışıyordu, sıcaklığı ve rahatlığı sayesinde mükemmel bir deneyimdi. Mutfak aletleri noktasında çok yeterli olduğu söylenemez ama bizim için yeterliydi. Ayni zamanda televizyon da netflix ve diğer eğlence içerikleri olması çok güzeldi. Odada temizlik havlu, şampuan gibi temizlik malzemeleri de vardi. Her şey için Mehmet beye ve ekibine çok teşekkür ederim.

description: You can easily access anywhere from this central location. Since it is in the heart of Akaretler, Beşiktaş's favorite district, you can easily sleep even on the weekend because it is very close to entertainment venues but away from the noise due to its location. All grocery stores, mosques, taxi stands and bus stops are 100-150 meters away. Museums can be visited 500-600 meters away. You can reach the pier in 10 minutes on foot and cross to Kadıköy and Üsküdar on the Asian continent in half an hour.

reviews.text:
We had an amazing 6-day stay at Cengiz's place in Istanbul! The location is absolutely perfect, one of the best in the city. It's just a quick 5-minute walk to Besiktas Iskilesi, where you can catch boats to Uskudar, Kadikoy, and Adalar. Plus, being only 2 minutes away from the lively bars and restaurants in Besiktas, the area is buzzing with energy all night long.
The place itself was clean and peaceful, offering a wonderful retreat after exploring the city each day.
Cengiz is a fantastic host and a genuinely great person. He was always responsive, making sure he took care of all our needs and ensuring we felt comfortable throughout our stay.
I highly recommend this accommodation to anyone visiting Istanbul, as it offers both an excellent location and a welcoming host who will make your stay truly enjoyable. Thank you, Cengiz!

Evin muhiti harikaydı. Her yere çok yakındı ve turistik yerler, güzel restoranlar ayağımızın altındaydı. Ancak ev yeterince temiz değildi. Çamaşır makinesinin içi kirliydi ve genel bir tozluluk hakimdi. En büyük artısı ev sahibinin iletişime açıklığıydı. Saat kaç olursa olsun mesajları anında cevapladı ve çözüm odaklıydı.

I love all about it, the host, the location, the space, the bed, everything! The fact that it’s a studio apartment is definitely something you’d not expect to get easily in Istanbul! Overall my stay was great! Thanks for the help!

Cengiz Bey büyük bir nezaketle erken giriş yapmama izin vermekle kalmadı erken saate rağmen dairenin içini harika şekilde temizlemiş ve hazırlamıştı. En küçük internet bağlantısı sorununda bile koşarak gelip ilgilendi. Konaklama süresince hal hatır ve ihtiyaç sormaya devam etti. Karşılama ve uğurlamada son derece sıcak, bilgilendirici ve ilgiliydi. Daireye gelince; evin içinde ihtiyacınız olabilecek her şey eksiksiz olarak var. Muhiti gezme odaklı gelenler için mükemmel, ben 5 gün boyunca neredeyse tüm meşhur ve tarihi yerleri gezerken hiçbir yerin ulaşımında sıkıntı yaşamadım. Restoran, cafe, alışveriş deseniz bölgenin en iyileri bir sokak altınızda zaten. Ben tek başına konakladım ama 2 kişi için de son derece yeterli ve çok hoş bir stüdyo daire. Ev sahibi de, ev de, bu konaklama deneyimi de benim beklentimin kat kat üzerindeydi, kesinlikle tavsiye ederim. Bu daire müsait olmasa bile bu ev sahibinin referansıyla her yeri gözünüz kapalı tercih edebilirsiniz, pişman olmazsınız…
Konum olarak harika toplu taşıma araçları vapur vs. Yürüme mesafesinde daire gayet temizdi ev sahibi Cengiz bey çok ilgilendi yardımcı oldu iletişim sorunsuzdu gayet memnun kaldım.

reviews.text: I explained to Chris I would not be writing a review. He has not been able to start repairs and I fear someone else will end up in our situation. 1. There's major water damage in this apartment- there is mold around the water pipes near the window- a large amount. There is water damage on the ceiling and around the door frames. There's mold in the bathroom with the shower- actual black mold around the sink. 2. The smaller bathroom smells like sewage. The light was flickering the whole time and did not work properly 3. One bathroom had no fan, the other has a fan that didn't work, but turned and made noise. 4. The ceiling is too thin- I've been up most nights with less then about 5 hours of sleep each night. I haven't slept tonight as I said. Honestly, the quality is less than a hostel with none of the advantages of a hostel (no kitchen, even paper towels or something to clean up a spill, cups for water, etc.). (Not enough space to add the rest of the message)

This is my third stay in this Airbnb, but my first time in this particular apartment. I think this fact speaks for itself. The apartment is very clean and looks exactly like it does in the pictures. The location is great, it’s very close to the bus and tram stations, and the metrobus station is about a 15-minute walk away. Chris is a great host, very professional and friendly. As for the downsides, I would only mention the size of the bathroom: the shower cabin is extremely small, and the sink isn’t big enough for comfortably washing your face or shaving. However, if you’re staying for only one or two nights, these minor issues aren’t really a problem, and for a longer stay, you can always choose another room in this Airbnb. (They are also very clean and nice)

I stayed at Chris’s place for only one night due to some challenges I faced, but I’d like to share my honest experience. The apartment is clean, well-maintained, and located in a serene area. Chris was very helpful throughout, and he kindly refunded me for the remaining days when I explained my situation.
That said, there are some things to consider. The property is in a hilly area, and walking back to it can be tough if you have mobility issues or an injury, as I did. For those who enjoy walking, this might not be a problem. However, the wooden flooring inside amplifies footsteps from upstairs, and even conversations outside can feel quite loud due to the quietness of the area. As a light sleeper, this was challenging for me.
Overall, the place might be a great fit for someone who doesn’t mind walking and isn’t bothered by occasional noise. Chris was accommodating and understanding, and I truly appreciate his support during my stay.

A very nice accommodation nearby many attractions in Istanbul.
The place was very clean and the bed is comfortable. Having 2 rooms it was nice since we could use the small desk to do our tasks while working on our laptop.
The place is very spacious, having all the you need for a comfortable stay, even a small fridge.
Chris was very responsive, providing all the details for an easy check-in.
I recommend this place if you are looking for a nice place to stay in Istanbul.

Great stay overall! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was friendly and responsive, and everything was smooth from check-in to our early check-out. There was a small issue with the door, but it didn’t affect our stay much. Would definitely recommend!

description:
Features AIR-COND rooms, a garden,free WiFi and a terrace.Situated 2.6 km from historical peninsula, 1.7 km from Istiklal Street and Galata Tower,1.2 km Spice Bazaar. We offers room service, a 24-hour front desk.

All rooms are fitted with a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, fridge,a kettle,a private bathroom,free toiletries,a wardrobe,a hairdryer and bed linen.

Istanbul Airport, 38 km from Mates Port Hotel.S.A.W. Airport

reviews.text: Everything you need, fully equipped hotel room with private bathroom, in a fantastic location - right at the heart of the old city, close to the waterfront and the Galara Bridge, yet tucked away in a quieter street so not noisy at night. Walking distance to main tourist attraction and loads of great restaurants and characterful cafes. Reception service open 24/7 and the gentleman at the front us very kind and helpful. Would go back & recommend!
This place is very worth the price. The room was a bit hot, but everything else was good. Very quiet location, nice host, and comfortable bed.

The apartment is very to stay for a short time, the bed is good, the shower is strong and hot and the AC is working properly. Also all the space in general was very clean and the location is strategic - it’s like 8 minutes walking from the Port.

Great location close to all sightseeing places.
All amenities described as in the listing.
Helpful and friendly receptionist, happy to sort out things as quickly as possible.
The main light in the room is too warm good to sleep only.
I had a very nice stay. The hotel is in a great location and the host war very helpful and always answered quickly.

description:
Hello, First of all, Welcome!

This house, which you can see in the images, is very close to the sea and is in the historical district of KADIKOY. It is on the Asian side of Istanbul. It is very central (very close to all public transportation) and at the same time in a quiet and peaceful location.
Kadıköy is the best and central place in Istanbul on the Asian side. It's very lively even at night with many cool bars and cafes. The people are friendly. Coffee shops and art stores are also on the street of this house where you will stay.
Our house is in the most CENTRAL part of Kadıköy.

reviews.text:
Good location, comfortable beds, and a fairly spacious apartment.
Unfortunately, the bed or bed linens had a noticeable smell as if someone with hygiene issues had been using it regularly.
The host is very responsive and fairly helpful. However, they forgot to leave towels and only brought them on the second day, which was not very nice.

We arrived late at night and we managed to find the kiosk that Recep told us the key was at (though it wasn’t so easy as the address didn’t take us to exactly there). When we asked about the Airbnb the man offered us 2 sets of keys but didn’t know which was ours and he also wasn’t sure where the apartment was! He pointed to a couple of doorways across the street and said he’d seen people going in and out of there!
The apartment is 4 floors up a very steep staircase and we had the wrong key to start with!
The apartment is spacious and fine - the fridge was dirty inside but other than that it was clean.
The next morning when we got up the water had been turned off and a note left outside the apartment door which was a demand for outstanding payments. We let Recep know, he told us it was a water cut in the local area and his bills were all paid. We went out for the day but when we got back, the water was still off. It eventually got put back on but not ideal. Great area

Öncelikle ilk günden beri sorularımızı yanıtsız bırakmayan Uğur ve Mehmet beye teşekkür ederiz. Ev çok rahat ve oldukça temizdi, kendi evinizdeymişsiniz hissi yaratıyor. Ev içinde ihtiyaç duyulabilecek her şey var ve konum olarak her yere yakındı. Bize göstermiş oldukları hizmetten dolayı teşekkür ederiz.
konum olarak çok merkezi, temiz ve fotoğraflarda gördüğünüz gibi :)
It’s a great stay. Very good location, easy access to ferry and other public transportation. Would recommend it to everyone who wants a nice location to the ferry. The host is very nice too.

description: Welcome to Suite 2, a sunlit retreat perfect for families. With one double and one single room, it offers a welcoming and comfortable environment for all. The sunlit suite exudes warmth and luxury. Its prime location makes it easy to get around town, and the chic decor and modern amenities ensure a pleasant stay. Choose Suite 2 for a family-friendly retreat in the heart of Istanbul.

reviews.text:
Very good location in the middle of several neighborhoods that are fun to walk around! Each neighborhood takes 5-10 min to walk to. Easy to get to the kabatas ferry terminal. Value cannot be beat! Harun was easy to communicate with and adding another person to the reservation wasn't a problem. We were a group of four and all thought it was a good value and nice place to stay. Harun also organized a transfer service from the airport for 45 euro, which worked out very easily and got us to the apartment without having to think. That was excellent.
Bathroom/shower could have been cleaner, as well as under the beds. A bare minimum of spices like salt and pepper would have also been good to have. The apartment was missing a kitchen dishtowel and hooks in the bathroom to hang towels. However, I think we would all stay at this location again.

A nice 2-bed flat at a very good location and very near to several public transport options. The access to the apartment building, however, is not everyone's cup of tea - lots of stairs (over 90steps) to climb to reach the property.
The property itself is quite good and reasonably priced. The host is extremely helpful and very responsive. Some extra attention to amenities should help and will be appreciated by the guests.

A wonderful apartment — clean, cozy, and very well maintained. It has everything you need for a comfortable and enjoyable stay. The location is excellent, the apartment is quiet and convenient, and the hosts are extremely friendly and helpful.
We had a fantastic stay and would definitely come back again. Highly recommended!

If you think about renting the place , the location is awesome and also the owner and the communication level. Only downside I had is that the room had dust and looked as it was not cleaned up. Also I found a small cockroach at the apartment. Other then that , I think it was worth It , instandsetzen for 2 nights so it was fine.

We had a wonderful stay! The host was incredibly welcoming from the moment we arrived – they made us feel right at home. The place was clean, cozy, and exactly as described.
I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area. Thank you for such a lovely experience!

reviews.text: I had a great stay at Pasha’s House. The host was very friendly and accommodating. I arrived with my mother and he immediately offered to change us to a Level 1 room if we needed. The place was exactly as described: clean, comfortable, and in a convenient location. It’s about a 5–10 minute uphill walk to the metro, with plenty of restaurants nearby and a convenience store right across the street. Overall, definitely worth the price paid. Highly recommended.

Barbaros was an excellent host. He made us feel very welcomedl, even offering his restaurant to use as our "living room" since the apartment does not have one, offering us free water and tea during our stay.
The rooms and bathrooms are very clean, and both offer great views of the very active (and safe) neighborhood.
Restaurants are everywhere. Make sure to try Barbaros' restaurant (Kumkapi Teriyaki) located beneath the Airbnb, the food and service was exceptional.
The metro is only a short 5 minute walk away, and so is coastal access and views.
The washer machine came in handy, as well as the iron and ironing board.
There is a travel agency (Raimond Travel) directly across from the Airbnb that offers reasonable airport transfers and other services. There is also a market right next to it where you can buy inexpensive bottled water, snacks, sodas, etc.
The only minor issues was the hot water, it seemed to run out quickly.
Otherwise, I would not hesitate to stay here again!

Bárbaros place was great! Clean, looked just liked photos! Great location. AC unit wasn’t working properly in upstairs. We reached to Bárbaro who quickly fixed it! Both AC unit kept house cold! No issues! Would recommend Bárbaro to anybody visited Istanbul!

This location is close to the old town stuff and the grand bazaar. However, it is a walk of 20-25 minutes to the cistern and other tourist attractions. You have to climb a steep hill to get to any where.
The duplex has excellent layout. However, the "kitchenette" is a bit small, so the microwave is in the bedroom together with the fridge. We had to clean it clean to avoid roaches etc.
The beds and mattresses are new and clean. The split unit ac's work very well.
The room on top has privacy and amazing large layout like the bedroom below. However, the internet was so poor and most of the times it was "out" and not working. That makes it super difficult when you have to work, even for a couple of hours. The power outage was more often than anticipated.
The host and the co-host are friendly and helpful.

The apartment is a 2-level upper floor unit, that requires a climb up 2-floors of a narrow winding staircase to get to the entrance. It is small but self-contained and very comfortable. There is a couch on the first floor that can sleep one person. It was very convenient to have 2 full shower/toilet for the 3 of us to share. There is no common sitting area and kitchenware are kept in a corner shelf outside the toilet. Microwave and fridge are inside the room. As we did not cook, this set-up was fine for us. We could boil water, make our own coffee, tea, etc.
Location wise, I got off the airport bus at Aksaray and it was a 20-min walk from there. Excellent location for sight seeing in the Sultanamet area. Lively and lots of eateries at the doorstep, yet, it was quiet for a good sleep at night.
Barbaros was very responsive and guided me to the location. They also allowed a one-hour late check out, so we did not have to hang out too long with luggage, before our flight. Thank you!

description: Experience a unique accommodation in this newly restored historical Istanbul house with high ceilings and equipped with the highest quality furnishings, in Cihangir, the ideal address to discover the soul of Istanbul. Your comfort has been considered with a fully equipped kitchen, elegant bedrooms and a modern bathroom. This apartment is waiting for you for an unforgettable Istanbul holiday with its location close to the lively atmosphere of Cihangir and famous places.

reviews.text: We had a great stay here! It’s just like the photos and is very clean. We loved the location- within just a few minutes you have a ton of cafe/bar/restaurants and on the same street there’s a little corner store. Also several big grocery stores a few minutes away. As other reviews said the bedroom is on an interior courtyard and is totally silent, while the living room is on the street (it’s not even very noisy but you can look out at some cafes to feel some energy). We worked remotely while here and the internet supported two people on calls and all our needs. Lastly, access was all digital keypads so we didn’t have to carry around a key. Would love to stay here again!

5/5 host, location, apartment (authentic but well appointed with modern accoutrements) and bedrooms w small balconies over quit courtyard. reviews.text: I’ve had a decent 2.5 weeks stay at Safa’s place. The bed was comfortable and I really appreciated having a washing machine. Just make sure to bring your own detergent pods as none were provided. Also there’s nowhere to dry your clothes - when asked for a drying rack, was promised it but nobody ever brought it. I personally had to improvise with hangers and kitchen shelves because the wardrobe isn’t really spacious. The kitchen is stocked moderately, there were no deep bowls or wine glasses in my room. However, other than that, it has all you need for mealmaking. If you don’t like cooking and eating out, Yemeksepeti is a perfect local delivery service that I used throughout my stay. Now regarding the downsides. First of all, it’s a small hotel so the room pictured and the room you’re going to get are not necessarily 2 same things. I got a smaller room than was pictured. My last night I had to change rooms and the one I got then (503) was substantially bigger and in substantially better condition (the shower in the first one 102 had leaks and even the cabin itself was very small) yet in the same category as the first one. Secondly, there was supposed to be cleaning twice a week but I only got it the first week (2 times). Next week, my room was completely ignored. Lastly, there might be some miscommunication so better to confirm everything in writing as I surprisingly found out that instead of staying another week I will be staying there just one day as the hotel is full yet I was under the impression (don’t pay now, pay if and when you’re extending) that there definitely was space. I then had less than 2 days to find a different place instead of 4. Overall, it’s a good find for a decent price if you know the quirks. Hopefully I was able to provide some insight!

What shall I say?

There is a great thing that the floor was parquet floor (wooden) and very clean. Also provided with towels.

Don't bother yourself searching the web, this is the place
Definitely gonna come back

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at Emrah’s apartment! The location is fantastic - it’s just a short walk to the Marmaray metro station, making it super convenient to get around the city, and there are plenty of great restaurants and cafes nearby for delicious meals.
The dedicated parking space in the underground garage was a huge plus, especially since parking can be tricky in the area. I
One of the absolute highlights was the stunning sea view from every corner of the apartment. Waking up to that view and enjoying it throughout the day was truly special.
The apartment itself is very well-equipped with lots of thoughtful amenities. The kitchen is modern, and stocked with everything you could need for cooking at home. The whole place felt comfortable, clean, and functional.
We highly recommend this listing and would definitely stay here again. Thanks Emrah to the host for a great experience.

The apartment complies with the description and attached photos.
The host is very communicative and responds immediately.
You can use the hotel swimming pool downstairs. For free! Cool!
There is also a quite good hotel restaurant and about 600 m away there is a very fashionable center with many different restaurants. The prices are very European, but the food is good.
Unfortunately, the apartment was definitely too noisy for us. You can hear the expressway loudly even though it is located on the 18th floor, which prevents us from sleeping with the windows open.
Unfortunately, the sofa in the living room is very damaged and unstable. I recommend replacement or repair.
Overall: 9/10

We (group of 3) stayed at Emrah's place for 2 weeks this Sept 2023.
Suite is as described/depicted in photos. Sea view is beautiful. Safe, calm area. Short walk/close to Fisekhane (restaurants/grocery/shops).
Cleaning supplies (dish soap, laundry detergent, bleach etc) provided - very helpful. We didn't use the dishwasher but noticed only 1 tab. Limited waste bag supplied (1). (Saved/used grocery bags from Carrefour as waste bags).
Emrah was a great host - friendly, quick & responsive to any questions/concerns. We encountered some issues - Emrah was available to assist/address quickly, without hesitation.
Overall, we were pleased with our stay.
Side note:
During our stay, there was an awful sewer smell that permeated throughout the entire suite. Odour was unpleasant/ stronger in the evenings. We don't think this was isolated to only Emrah's suite (could be entire condo building/area issue?) Locals may be nose blind to sewer smell. Radisson Blu hotel seemed to be ok though.
